stong phrag brgya pa/①༄7༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ glegs bam gsum pa/② bam po dang po②/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed 0par/ skye mched drug nang stong pa ⑤zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do//de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba 16—3

myed par/ skye mched drug phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug stong pa nyid stong pa ①zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid ②la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug don dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ③don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi ༷pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa 16—4

nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/skye mched drug mtha' las 'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/skye mched drug thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma ②skyed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/skye mched drug rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa 16—5

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi ①mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul kyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do//de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye mched drug dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams 16—6

cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nyustong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de / dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/reg pa don dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su 16—7

byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa mtha' las 'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba skyed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan 16—8

pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/reg pa rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ①kyang 16—9

dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i ①yid la bya ba myed par/ reg pa dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do//rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/tshor ba phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor —ba phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba med par/ tshor ba stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/16—10

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba med par/ tshor ba don dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/tshor ba mtha' las 'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i 16—11

tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/tshor ba dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed ①de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi 16—12

pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshor ba ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/tshor ba dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/sred pa nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sred pa phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/16—13

zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ srid pa ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ srid pa dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa 16—23

nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba skyed par/skye ba stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba don ①dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba mtha' las 16—24

'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong 16—25

pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par / skye ba myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de①/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ skye ba dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 16—26

spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par / rga shi phyi stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba skyed par/ rga shi phyi nang stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi chen po stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi don dam pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi 'dus byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong 16—27

pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par / rga shi 'dus ma byas stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi mtha' las 'das pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs ①pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par rga shi dor ba myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi rang bzhin stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 16—28

nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi ①chos thams cad stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi myi dmyigs pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rga shi dngos po myed pa stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po skyed pa stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/rga shi ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba skyed par/ rga shi dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa zhes bya bar yid la byed de/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po 16—29

myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dmyigs la/ stong pa nyid kyis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ dran pa nye bar gzhag ①pa rnams sgom ②ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do / /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ yang dag par spong ba rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par spong ba de dag kyang dmyigs la/ yang dag par spong ba de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams sgom ste/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ dbang po rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dbang po de dag kyang dmyigs la/ dbang po de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ stobs rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stobs de dag kyang dmyigs la/ stobs de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa 16—30

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub kyi yan lag de dag kyang dmyigs ①la/ byang chub kyi yan lag de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed dol/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa de dag kyang ②dmyigs la/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa de dag gis 0kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i bden pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ 'phags pa'i bsden pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/bsam gtan rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bsam gtan de dag kyang dmyigs la/ bsam gtan de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ tshad myed pa rnams sgom ste/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshad myed pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ tshad myed pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom ste④/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 16—31

gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rnam par thar pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par thar pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ rnam par thar pa de dag bis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnarmes sgom ste dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa de dag gis ①kyang rlom sems su byed do//de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ mngon ②par shes pa rnams sgom ste/dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mngon par shes pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ mngon par shes pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya 16—32

ba myed par/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ting nge 'dzin de dag kyang dmyigs la/ ting nge 'dzin de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis gzungs kyi sgo de dag kyang dmyigs la/gzungs kyi sgo de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs de dag kyang dmyigs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ myi 'jigs ①pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi 'jigs ②pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ myi 'jigs ①pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis so so yang dag par rig pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ so so yang dag par rig pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ snying rje chen po sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis snying rje chen po de yang rjodamyigs la snying rje chen po des ①kyang rlom sems su byed do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu 16—33

phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba myed par/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sgom ste/ dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa de dag kyang dmyigs la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa de dag gis kyang rlom sems su byed do// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gnyis ①pa/rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ de ltar thabs myi mkhas pas ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa 'di thos na③/ 'jigs shing sngang dul skrag par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs su zin cing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pa 'di thos na/ 'jigs shing sngang dul skrag par 'gyur te/ sdig pa'i grogs po'i sug par ltung dub lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ④sdig pa'i grogs po ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa med par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa med par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa med par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o⑧/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa myed par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o / /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa myed par byed cing zlog par byed pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa mos pa skyed par byed cing zlog par byed pa ste0/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ma 16—34

yin/ 'di ni chos ma yin/ 'di ①ni 'dul ba ma yin gyis②/ ③'di la bslab par bya ba'i dusnyi cha'o/ /mdo sde 'di dag ni rang bzor byas pa ste/'di dag ni mnyan par myi bya'o/ /gzung bar myi bya'o/ /bcang bar myi bya'o/ /klag ⑤par myi bya'o/ /kun chub par myi bya'o/ /tshul bzhin du yid la myi bya'o/ /'di dag ni gzhan la bstan par myi bya'o zhes zer ba 'di duni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o//rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs po ni 'di ltar bdud sdig to can/ sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas pa dag /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du 'ongs nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug las zlog cing mos pa myed par byed de/ rigs kyi bu skes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms ⑦pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas khyod la ci zhig bya/ zhes zer ba 'ong ngo zhes bdud kyi las myi ston/ bdud kyi nyes pa myi ston pa 'di ni/rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te nyan thos dang ldan pa'i mdo dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang /lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang /16—35

gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang /gtan la phab ①pa bstan pa dag ston to/ /'grel to rnam par 'byed do/ /gsal bar byed do/ /yongs su ston to/ /zhes bdud kyi las rnam pa 'di lta bu dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ②ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por ③rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag④ /sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu khyod la ni/byang chub ⑤kyi sems kyang duchung ༅zad kyang myed/ khyod ni phyir myi ldog pa yang ⑧ma yin/ khyod kyis ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang myi nus so/ /zhes zer ba 'di lta bu'i ⑨bdud kyi las dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ⑩ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig ⑩par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag /sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ 'di skad du rigs kyi bu/ gzugs ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'du shes ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'du byed ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ngamyig ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sna ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lce ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lus ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yid ni 16—36

bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /gzugs ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sgra ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dri ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ro ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /reg ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo //chos ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sa'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /chu'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /me'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rlung 16—37

gi khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /nam mkha'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ma rig pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'du byed ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par shes pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mying dang gzugs ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /skye mched drug ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / / reg pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /①tshor ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sred pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /len pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /srid pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /skye ba ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rga shi ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo //brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /phyi stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /chen po stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mtha' las 'das pa stong 16—38

pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /dbang po rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /stobs rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /bsam gtan rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /tshad myed pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par thar pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /mngon 16—39

par shes pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni bdag gam ①bdag gis stong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /snying rje chen po ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni bdag gam bdag gis stong ngo / /de ltar bdag gam ②bdag gis stong na/bla na skyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas te/yang ①ci zhig bya zhes zer ba ④de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra mi ston pa 'di ni / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig ⑤par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te / 'di skad du rigs kyi bu/ shar phyogs ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos rnams kyis stong ste/ 'di la sangs rgyas zhes ⑥bya ba yang ⑦skyed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba yang duskyed do/ /nyan thos zhes bya ba yang myed do/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang /dhi 'og dang / steng dag kyang stong ste/ phyogs bcu kun kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos rnams kyis stong pas/ 'di la sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yang tu )myed/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba yang myed/16wa 40

nyan thos zhes bya ba yang myed do/ /zhes zer ba 'di lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag nyan thos kyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba las zlog cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas 'dems ①shing rjes su ston pa de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o②/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag mkhan po dang / slob dpon gyi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las zlog cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba las zlog ②ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams la sbyor ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / dbang po rnams la sbyor ba dang / stobs rnams la sbyor ba dang /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la sbyor ba dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la sbyor ba dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la sbyor ba dang /bsam gtan rnams la sbyor ba dang / tshad myed pa rnams la sbyor ba dang /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / rnam par thar pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la sbyor ba dang / stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i 16—41

chos rnams la sbyor zhing / rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar chos de dag yongs su bsgoms ①la/ nyan thos kyi sa mngon du gyis shig /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis khyod la ci zhig bya zhes zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag pha dang ma'i cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du ②phyin te/ 'di skad du bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par dusangs rgyas pas/ khyod la ci zhig bya de'i don du ni bskal pa tshad myed grangs myed 0par 'khor ba na 'khor zhing rkang lag dang mgo gcad 0pa tshad myed pas/ nyon mongs par 'gyur gyisaX/gang la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byar yod pa dang / lan cig ⑦phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du byar yod pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mngon du byar yod pa dang / dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byar yod pa de dul brtson par gyis shig /ces zer ba de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag mi smra mi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs por rig ⑨par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag /dge slong gi cha byad ⑩du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phyin te/ gzugs myi rtag ces bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / gzugs sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang phonye/ mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /16—42

dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / tshor ba myi rtag ces bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / tshor ba sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / 'du shes myi rtag ces bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang /'du shes sdug bsngal ①zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon ②par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / 'du byed mi rtag ces bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / 'du byed sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rnam par shes pa sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / myig mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /ni mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang /16—43

smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rna ba myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang /smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / sna myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / lce 2pyi rtag ces bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / lus myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / yid myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar 16—44

dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / gzugs mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba ①med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / sgra mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / dri mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / ro myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs ②pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / reg myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / chos myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug 16—45

bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal lazhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs ①pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang /②lce'i rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya 16—46

ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang /mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul kyis ston pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang /rtse'i 'dus te reg pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /16—47

bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba ①dang /mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa skyed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba ②dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang /mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis ⑧tshor ba mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba skyed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba 16—48

myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du ①bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang /mngon par 'du bya ba skyed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / jimangon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / sa'i khams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed rtes bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston 16—49

mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rnam par thar pa rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba ②skyed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang /mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang /sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /16—60

stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba ①dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / gzungs ②kyi sgo rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang /mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes 16—61

bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / byams pa chen po myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / snying rje chen po myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag myed ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang /smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang /dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ①chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi rtag ces bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /bdag skyed ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma myed ces bya ba dang / smon pa myed ces bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya bar dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ston pa ②de lta bu'i bdud kyi las kyi rnam pa dag myi smra myi ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sdig pa'i grogs ③por rig par bya'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sdig pa'i grogs po rnams rigs dupar bya ste/ de ltar shes nas kyang yongs su spang bar bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bdun rnal// //16—62

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po gsum ①pa/de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba'i tshig 'di'i ②don gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ③tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni/ tshig gi don skyed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub kyang ma skyes la/ sems can yang ma skyes pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor byang chub la yang 0tshig myed/ sems can la yang ⑤tshig myed pas/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni/ tshig gi don myed pa'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor byang chub la ni skye ba'am/yod pa nyid dam/ yod pa nye bar myi dmyigs so/ /durab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/⑦ nam mkha' la bya'i rjes myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ spyi lam la gnas med do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu byam la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ rtsig rgyu la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chu zla la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgra brnyan la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don 16—63

myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ myig yor la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gzugs brnyan la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don skyed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/de bzhin nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab ①'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chos nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chos kyi ②dbyings la gnas myed do / /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chos kyi zhuganas nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chos skyon myed pa nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 16—64

'di lta ste dper na/ bden pa nyid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/① sna ma'i skyes bu'i gzugs la gnas myed do/ /tshor ba la gnas myed do/ /'du shes la gnas myed do/ /'du byed la gnas med do/ /rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i mig la gnas myed do/ /rna ba la gnas myed do/ /sna la gnas myed do/ /lce la gnas myed do/ /lus la gnas myed do/ /yid la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i gzugs la gnas myed do/ /sgra la gnas myed do/ /dri la gnas myed do/ /ro la gnas myed do/ /reg la gnas myed do/ /chos la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i myig gi rnam par shes pa la ②gnas myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la duganas myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa la duganas myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa la ⑤gnas myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa la ⑥gnas myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa la ⑦gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu 16—65

phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i myig gi 'dus te reg pa la ①gnas myed dol/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la ②gnas myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa la ①gnas myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa la duganas myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la duganas myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la duganas myed do / /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la ⑦gnas myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la niganas myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la ⑨gnas myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la tunyeganas myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la ⑩gnas myed do//yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la tsoganas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ / rab 'byor ⑫'di lta ste dper na/ bosgyu ma'i skyes bu'i sa'i khams la gnas myed do/ /chu'i khams la gnas myed do/ /mye'i khams la gnas myed do/ /rlung gi khams la gnas myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams la gnas myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tunyeshes rab kyi (nyepha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/za8 sgyu 16—66

ma'i skyes bu'i ma rig pa la gnas myed do/ /'du byed la gnas myed do/ /rnam par shes pa la gnas myed do/ /mying dang gzugs la gnas myed do/ /skye mched drug la gnas myed do/ /reg pa la gnas myed do/ /tshor ba la gnas skyed do/ /sred pa la gnas myed do/ /len pa la gnas myed do/ /srid pa la gnas myed do/ /skye ba la gnas myed do/ /rga shi la gnas myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshig gi don skyed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshig gi don skyed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ①la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshig gi don skyed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu phyi stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/16—67

sgyu ma'i skyes bu phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu chen po stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do//rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu chos thams cad stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed 16—68

do / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na①/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu yang dag par spong ba rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/sgyu ma'i skyes bu ladzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu dbang po rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu stobs rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/sgyu ma'i skyes bu byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyod pa'i tshig gi ②don myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don med do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ / rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/du sgyu ma'i skyes bu bsam gtan rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed deX/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshig gi don myed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i skyes bu gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la 16—69
