zhe snang zad pa/ gti mug zad pa/ de bzhin nyid ma nor ba de bzhin nyid①/gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid/ chos nyid/ chos kyi dbyings/ chos skyon myed pa nyid/ bsam gyis myi khyab ②pa'i dbyings yang dag pa'i mtha' ste/rab 'byor de dag ni 'dus ma byas kyi chos zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thun mong gi chos gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor thun mong gi chos zhes bya ba ni/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang /mngon par shes pa lnga dag ste/ de dag ni byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams dang /thun mong gi chos zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das thun mong ma lags pa'i chos ②gang dulags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor thun mong ma yin pa'i chos zhes bya ba ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang /rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ⑤brgyad dag ste/ de dag ni thun mong ma yin pa'i chos zhes bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 16—143

chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas①/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos thams cad la rtog pa myed pas chags par myi bya'o/ /chos thams cad gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis rtog pa myed cing / rnam par rtog pa myed pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad khong du chud par bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang 'di byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba de ②ci'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' ①sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor sems can gyi phung po chen po nges pa'i phul byed par ④'gyur bas de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gyi phung po chen po ②nges pa ⑥de lta bu'i phul/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bgyid par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i sems can gyi phung po chen po ༅nges pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor sems can gyi phung po chen po ⑧zhes bya ba ni/ rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa ⑨dang /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig 0phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang /dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nas/ phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bar dag ste/ rab 'byor de ni sems can gyi phung po chen po 7nges pa zhes bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni de lta bu'i phul du tsunyebyed par 'gyur ro/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rdo 8rje lta bu'i sems bskyed de/ sems can gyi phung po 16—144

chen po nges pa'i phul zhes ①bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ltar sems bskyed de/ 'khor ba dpag tu myed par sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis go cha ②bgo bar bya'o/ /bdag gis bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtang ①bar bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid bskyed par bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad theg pa gsum gyis yongs su mya ngan las bzla dubar bya'o/ /de ltar sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzlas 0kyang / sems can gang yang duyongs su mya ngan las bzlas ⑦pa myed pas/ chos thams cad skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa bdag gis shes par bya'o/ /bdag gis ma 'dres pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyad par bya'o/ /bdag gis chos rtogs pa thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba phun sum tshogs pa la bslab par bya'o/ /bdag gis chos kyi tshul gcig tu bsgrub pa khong du chud par bya'o/ /bdag gis chos dpag tu myed pa thams cad yongs su bsgrub par bslab par ⑧bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed de/ rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems bskyed pa rdo rje lta bu ste/ de la gnas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems can gyi phung po chen po nges pa'i phul mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di ltar sems bskyed despu/ sems can dmyal ba pa dang / byol song tunyegi skye gnas pa hunyedang / gshin rje'i 'jig 16—145

rten pa'i sems can ji snyed cig① /sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba nyams su ⑦myong bar gyur pa'i①/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba de dag thams cad sems can de rjodag gi don du bdag gis ⑤nyams su myong bar bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed do//de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ gong 0du sems 'di ltar bskyed par bya ste/ bdag gis sems can re re'i don du yang bskal ⑦pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang por/ sems can gang yang phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las ma bzlas nikyi bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de dag kyang / bdag gis nyams su myong bar bya'o//zhes thabs de lta bus sems can thams cad kyi don du/ sems can thams cad phung po ma lus pa'i/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las ma bzlas 0kyi bar du sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de dag thams cad kyang nyams su myong bar bya'o/ /de nas gzod ⑩bdag gi ⑩don du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed de/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas/ byang chub kyi tshogs mang po bstsags phonyete/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed par bya ste0/rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems bskyed pa rdo rje lta bu ste/ de la gnas shing ④byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can gyi phung po chen po nges pa'i phul mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad 8par rlabs tsopo che'i sems gang gis/ sems can thams cad ⑩kyi phul du 'gyur ba/ de lta bu'i sems rlabs tsopo che bskyed par bya'o/ /de la 16—146

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems rlabs ①po che ni/ sems dang po bskyed phyin chad ②'dod chags kyi sems mi skyedag/ zhe sdang gi sems mi skyedabya/ gti mug gi sems mi skyed⑤/ gtse ba'i sems mi skyedabya/ nyan thos kyi sems mi skyedagye/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sems mi skyed ⑧pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems rlabs khyapo che'o/ /des ⑩ sems can thams cad kyi phul byed kyang / sems rlabs tunyepo che des rlom sems su myi bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ mi sgul ba'i sems dang ldan par bya ste'u/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems myi sgul 8ba ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i 8yid la byed cing / des rlom 8sems 0su mi byed pa ste/'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems mi sgul ba'o/ /des sems can thams cad kyi phul du myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba'i sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i phan pa dang / bde ba'i sems ni sems can thams cad spre)skyob cing / sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong la/ des rlom sems su 'gyur ba myed pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i phan pa dang / bde ba'i sems te/de la gnas shing sems can gyi phung po chen po nges pa'i phul myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad 8par chos 'dod par bya'o/ / chos la dga' 16—147

bar bya'o/ /chos la mos par bya'o/ /①chos la mos pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson par bya'o/ /de la chos gang zhe na/ chos thams cad dbyer myed pa ste/ 'di ni chos zhes bya'o/ /de la chos 'dod pa gang zhe na/ gang chos de la 'dod cing mos pa ste/ 'di ni chos 'dod pa zhes bya'o/ /de la chos la dga' ba gang zhe na/ gang chos de la dga' zhing mngon par dga' ba ②ste/ 'di ni chos la dga' ba zhes bya'o/ /de la chos la mos pa gang zhe na/ gang chos de la yon tan du blta ①ba ste/ 'di ni chos la mos pa zhes bya'o/ /de la chos la mos pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa gang zhe na/ chos de nyid la sgom ༷zhing mang du byed pa ste/ 'di ni chos la mos pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ sems can gyi phung po chen po nges pa'i phul mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po2/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ nang stong pa nyid la gnas/ phyi stong pa nyid la gnas/ phyi nang stong pa nyid la gnas / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la gnas/ chen po stong pa nyid la gnas/don dam pa stong pa nyid la gnas/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid la gnas/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la gnas/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la gnas / thog ⑥ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid la gnas/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la gnas/ rangabazhin stong pa nyid la gnas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la gnas/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la gnas/ mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la gnas/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la gnas/16—148

ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gnas/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la gnas te/ sems can gyi phung po chen po nges pa'i phul du 'gyur bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la gnas/yang dag par spong ba rnams la gnas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la gnas/dbang po rnams la gnas/ stobs rnams la gnas/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la gnas/ 'phags pa'i lam ①yan lag brgyad pa la gnas/'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la gnas/ bsam gtan rnams la gnas/tshad med pa rnams la gnas/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la gnas/ rnam par thar pa rnams la gnas/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la gnas/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa la gnas/ mngon par shes pa rnams la gnas/ ting nge 'dzin rnams la gnas/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams la gnas/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la gnas/ mi 'jigs pa rnams la gnas/so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la gnas/ byams pa chen po la gnas/snying rje chen po la gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad la gnas te/ sems can gyi phung po chen po nges pa'i phul du mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis 'gyur bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rin chen phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/seng ge rnam par rtse ②ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ zla ba bzang po'i ting nge 16—149

'dzin la gnas/ zla ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/chos thams cad las shin tu 'phags pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ spyi gtsug rnam par lta ①ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos kyi dbyings su nges pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/nges pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rdo rje'i ②ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / ting nge 'dzin la nirgyal po ltar rab tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / rab tu bde bar gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po bde bar 'jugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/du 'od zer ⑤rab tu 'gyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'khrul pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pas 'khrul pa med par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ brtson pa'i stobs kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/rjo dpung rnam (7)par 6)dgod ⑨pa'i ting nge 'dzin ⑩la gnas/ yang dag par 'phags pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ nges pa'i tshig la yigadon mi za bar 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ tshig bla dgas hunyel yang dag par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ phyogs su rnam par lta 8ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ nyam pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos thams cad yang dag par 'du ba rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rgyal po'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/(stenam 8mkha' rgyas par 'gengs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 16—150

'dzin la gnas/① rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/dbang po'i ②dpal gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rgyun gyi ②rjes su song ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ seng ge rnam par rkyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ seng ge rnam par glal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/du snrel zhi'i ⑤ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/du nyon mongs pa ༅spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rnam par snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ tshol ⑧ba myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ gnas la rten ⑨pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ sems myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/0 dri ma myed pa'i sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'od mtha' yas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'od byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ dag pa dam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'od dri ma skyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/dga' ba byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ glog gi sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ zad myi shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ myi 'pham 0pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ gzi brjid yod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ zad pa dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ myi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rab tu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/8 'jig pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ nyi ma'i sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ zla ba dri ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ mig yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/tunyeshes rab sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ snang ba gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin 16—151

la gnas/ zla ba'i sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/① snang ba byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ bya ba byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ ye shes dpal gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/sems gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / rab tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rin chen mtha'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos dam pa'i phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ dga' ba spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos kyis ②'phags pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos kyis 'phags pas yongs su rgyas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rin po che nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'khrug nga/ spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/zhurnam par 'thor ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos thams cad kyi tshig rab tu 'byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rnam par nges pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / dri ma med par spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/bya yi ge mnyam par 'god rgyapa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ yi ge dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ dmyigs pa gcod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'gyur ba myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rnam pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ ming dang mtshan ma la 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ bya ba dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/( mying nges par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/gnas myed par spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rab rib myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ spyod pa dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ g.yo ba myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ yul las rgal ⑦ba'i ting nge 'dzin la 16—152

gnas / yon tan thams cad kyi tshogs su gyur pa'i ⑨ting nge 'dzin la gnas/sems myed par gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ nges par gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/② dge ba'i me tog rgyas shing gsal ba'i ②ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ byang chub kyi yan lag yod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/spobs pa mtha' yas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ mtha' yas sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas /④ phyi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/chos thams cad las 'da' ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ yongs su gcod pa byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ nem nur rnam par sel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ gnas su bya ba myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ gcig tu rnam par bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rnam pa mngon par bsgrub ⑤pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rnam pa gcig tu gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/rnam pa 'dor ba myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ spyod pa dam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/༅ rtogs pas srid pa'i gzhi thams cad khong du chud pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ brda ⑦dang sgra la 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rin chen snying po'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos thams cad la chags pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ glog gi 'od zer bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / spong ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ chos kyi sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / ye shes sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/du sgra dbyangs kyi yi ge dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ sgron ma 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / mtshan nyid yo/ngas su sbyong ba'i ⑨ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ mngon 16—153

par dmyigs ①pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ ma 'dres pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ gzungs dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/②bde ba dang sdug bsngal thams cad la mngon par dga' ba myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ zad myi shes pa'i za ma tog gi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/gzungs kyi blo ④gros kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ yang dag pa dang log pa thams cad yang dag par sel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'gal ba dang 'gog pa thams cad yang dag par ④zhi bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/mthun (shepa dang 'gal ba myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'od dri ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ snying po dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/zla ba dri ma myed par rgyas pa'i 'od kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ glog gi 'od kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rgyan duchen po'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rnam pa thams cad du 'od byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ 'jig rten thams cad skyob pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ga ting nge 'dzin mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ rdul myed cing rdul dang bral ba'i tshul dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ nyon mongs pa myed par yang dag par gzhol ba'i ting nge ⑧'dzin la gnas/ nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa thams cad nyon mongs pa myed par ⑨yang dag par gzhol ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ gnas dmyigs su myed pa la brtson pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas de bzhin nyid la gnas shing sems myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ snod las rang 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / nyon mongs pa thams cad sreg pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ ye 16—154

shes chen po'i sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ stobs bcu'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ sgo rnam par 'byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas / ① lus kyi skyon yang dag par sel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ngag gi skyon rnam par 'jig pas nam mkha' ltar gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ ngag gi skyon yang dag par sel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/② yid kyi skyon yang dag par sel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ kun tu rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/ nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas/③nam mkha' ltar chags pa myed pas rnam par grol ④zhing gos pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas te/ sems can gyi phung po chen po nges pa'i phul du myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'gyur bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor chos de dag la gnas shing /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa⑤/ sems can gyi phung po chen po dunges pa'i phul byed pas/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o// //⑦shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po drug ⑧pa/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha stir dwa ti'i bus/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don gang gi slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ zhes bgyi ba 'di la bdag kyang spobs pa skye'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu don tu)gang gi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' ⑩sems dpa' chen po zhes bya ba de la spobs pa skyed cig/sha ra dwa ti'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag tu lta ba rab tu spang ba'i 8slad du/ sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang / sems can du lta ba 16—155

rab tu spang ba dang / srog tu lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / gang zag tu lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / gso bar lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / skyes bur lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / shed can du lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / shed bdag tu lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / byed pa por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / byed du 'jug pa por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / slong ba por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang /yongs su slong ba por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / tshor ba por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / tshor du 'jug pa por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang/ shes pa por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / mthong ba por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / chad par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / rtag par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / yod par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / myed par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / phung por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / khams su lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / skye mched du lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bar lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / bden par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / pha rol tu phyin par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / stong pa nyid du lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / yang dag par spong bar lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / dbang por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / stobs su lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / byang chub kyi yan lag du lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad par ①lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / 'phags pa'i bden par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / bsam gtan du lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / tshad med par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug par lta ba rab tu 16—156

spang ba dang / rnam par thar par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / mngon par shes par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin du lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / gzungs kyi sgor ①lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs su lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / myi 'jigs par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / so so yang dag par rig par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / byams pa chen por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / snying rje chen por lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres par lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / sems can yongs su sbyin par bya bar ②lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya bar ①lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / byang chub tu lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / sangs rgyas su lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / chos su lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / dge 'dun du lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ④bar lta ba rab tu spang ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar lta ba rab tu spang ba'i slad du/sems can rnams la chos ston par dubagyid kyang de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bgyid de/ de'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi'o//de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu ci'i phyir na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzugs su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ 'du shes su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ 'du byed du lta 16—157

bar 'gyur ba yin/ rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ myig tu lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rna bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ snar lta bar 'gyur ba yin / lcer lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ lus su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ yid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ gzugs su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sgrar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ drir lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ ror lta bar 'gyur ba yin/reg tu lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ chos su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ myig gi rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rna ba'i rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sna'i rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ lce'i rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ lus kyi rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/yid kyi rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ myig gi 'dus te reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sna'i 'dus te reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ lce'i 'dus te reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ lus kyi 'dus te reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ yid kyi 'dus te reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sa'i khams su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ chu'i khams su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ mye'i khams su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rlung gi khams su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/16—158

nam mkha'i khams su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rnam par shes pa'i khams su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ ma rig par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ 'du byed du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ mying dang gzugs su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ skye mched drug tu lta bar 'gyur ba yin/reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sred ①par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ len par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ srid par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ skye bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rga shir lta bar 'gyur ba yin / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ nang stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/phyi stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ chen po stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/'dus byas stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa khunyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ mi dmigs pa stong pa 16—159

nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ yang dag par spong bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ dbang por lta bar 'gyur ba yin/stobs su skyelta bar 'gyur ba yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag tu lta bar 'gyur ba yin / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/'phags pa'i bden par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ bsam gtan du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ tshad myed par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rnam par thar par lta bar 'gyur ba yin / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ mngon par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ting nge 'dzin du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ gzungs kyi sgor lta bar 'gyur ba yin/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ mi 'jigs par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ so so yang dag par rig par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/byams pa chen por lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ snying rje chen por lta bar 'gyur ba yin / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sems can yongs su spyin par bya bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ byang chub tu lta bar 'gyur ba yin/sangs rgyas su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ chos su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ dge 16—160

'dun du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ①bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / thabs mi mkhas pas gzugs su dmyigs shing / dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /tshor bar dmyigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /'du shes su dmyigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /'du byed du dmyigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rnam par shes par dmyigs shing / dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /myig tu dmyigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rna bar dmyigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /snar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /lcer dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /chus su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /yid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /gzugs su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sgrar dmigs shing ②dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /drir dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed ②do/ /ror dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /reg tu dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed ④do/ /chos su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /mig gi rnam par shes par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes par dmigs 16—161

shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes par dmigs shing / dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /mig gi 'dus te reg par dmigs shing / dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ lce'i 'dus te reg par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar dmigs shing /dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /lus kyi ①'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sa'i khams su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /chu'i khams su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /me'i khams su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rlung gi khams su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /nam mkha'i khams su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rnam par shes 16—162

pa'i khams su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /ma rig par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /'du byed du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rnam par shes par ①dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /mying dang gzugs su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /skye mched drug tu dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ②lta ba skyed do/ /reg par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /tshor bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sred par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /len par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /srid par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /skye bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rga shir dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do / /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /nang stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i 16—163

tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /dngos po med pa ②stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed ②do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /yang dag par spong bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ①ba skyed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /dbang por dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /stobs su dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ④lta ba skyed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed ⑤do/ /'phags 16—164

pa'i lam yan lag brgyad par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /'phags pa'i bden par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /bsam gtan du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /tshad med par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rnam par thar par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par ①dmyigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /smon pa med par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /mngon par ②shis par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /ting nge 'dzin du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /gzungs kyi sgor dmyigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs su dmyigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /myi 'jigs par dmyigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /so so yang dag par rig par ⑧dmyigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /byams pa chen por dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /snying rje chen por dmyigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres par dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sems can yongs su sbyin par bya bar dmyigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya bar ④dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do / /byang chub tu dmyigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /16—165

sangs rgyas su dmigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /chos su dmyigs shing dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /dge 'dun du dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ①bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar dmigs shing dmigs pa'i tshul gyis lta ba skyed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor de'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/gzugs su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ tshor bar lta ba dang / 'du shes su lta ba dang / 'du byed du lta ba dang / rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/de'i phyir mig tu lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rna bar lta ba dang / snar lta ba dang /lcer lta ba dang / lus su lta ba dang / yid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir gzugs ②su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sgrar lta ba dang / drir lta ba dang /ror lta ba dang / reg tu lta ba dang / chos su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir mig gi rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin / rna ba'i rnam par shes par lta ba dang / sna'i rnam par shes par lta ba dang / lce'i rnam par shes par lta ba dang / lus kyi rnam par shes par lta ba dang / yid kyi rnam par shes par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir myig gi 'dus te reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg par lta ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg par lta ba dang / rtse'i 'dus te reg par lta ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te ④reg par lta ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/de'i phyir mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg 16—166

pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir sa'i khams su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ chu'i khams su lta ba dang / me'i khams su lta ba dang / rlung gi khams su lta ba dang / nam mkha'i khams su lta ba dang /rnam par shes pa'i khams su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir ma rig par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ 'du byed du lta ba dang / rnam par shes par ①lta ba dang /ming dang gzugs su lta ba dang / skye mched drug tu lta ba dang / reg par lta ba dang / tshor bar lta ba dang / sred par lta ba dang / len par lta ba dang /srid par lta ba dang / skye bar lta ba dang / rga shir lta bar 'gyur ba yin/de'i phyir sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par lta ba dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin par lta ba dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin par lta ba dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin par lta ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/de'i phyir nang stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ phyi stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / chen po stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid du lta ba dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid du lta ba 16—167

dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du lta ba dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir dran pa nye bar gzhag par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/yang dag par spong bar lta ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang par lta ba dang /dbang por lta ba dang / stobs su lta ba dang / byang chub kyi yan lag tu lta ba dang / lam du lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir 'phags pa'i bden par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ bsam gtan du lta ba dang / tshad myed par lta ba dang /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug par lta ba dang / rnam par thar par lta ba dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug par lta ba dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med par lta ba dang /mngon par shes par lta ba dang / ting nge 'dzin du lta ba dang / gzungs kyi sgor lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs su lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ myi 'jigs par lta ba dang / so so yang dag par rig par lta ba dang / byams pa chen por lta ba dang /① snying rje chen por lta ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres par lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i phyir sems can yongs su sbyin par bya bar lta bar 'gyur ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya bar lta ba dang / byang chub tu lta ba dang / sangs rgyas su lta ba dang / chos su lta ba dang / dge 'dun du lta ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar ②lta ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar lta bar 'gyur ba ①yin te/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha 16—168

rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ thabs mkhas pas lta ba'i rnam pa de dag spang ba'i phyir myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos ston to/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don gang gi slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba de la bdag kyang spobs pa skye'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor khyod kyis nyuspobs pa skyed cig /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems myi mnyam ②pa dang mnyam pa'i sems nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma lags pa'i sems de lta bu la ①yang chags pa ma mchis pas/ de'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi'oX/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems de ni zag pa ma mchis shing khongs su chud pa ma mchis pa ste/ de ltar thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems zag pa ma mchis shing khams gsum gyi khongs su chud pa ⑤ma mchis pa'i sems de la yang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi slad du chags pa ma mchis pas/ de'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' ⑥sems dpa' chen po'i grangs su mchi'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ⑦ma yin pa'i sems gang yin/ rab 'byor kyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed duphyin chad / chos gang yang skye bar yang dag par rjes su myi mthong / 'gag pa 16—169

dang / 'phel ba dang 'grib pa dang / 'ong ba dang 'gro ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang bar yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gang la skye ba myed cing / 'gag pa myed pa dang /'phel ba myed cing 'grib pa myed pa dang 'ong ba myed cing 'gro ba myed pa dang /kun nas nyon mongs pa myed cing rnam par byang ba myed pa de la nyan thos kyi sems myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi sems myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ①sems myed do/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sems myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / thun mong ma ②yin pa'i sems so/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gang khyod kyis 'di skad du/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems zag pa myed pa/ khongs su chud pa myed pa/ de lta bu'i sems la yang chags pa myed do/ /zhes smras pa de ①ni de lta ④yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor de bas gegazugs kyang chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba yang chags pa myed do / /'du shes kyang chags pa myed do/ /'du byed kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /myig kyang chags pa myed do/ /rna ba yang chags pa skyed do/ /sna yang chags pa myed do/ /lce yang chags pa myed do / /lus kyang chags pa myed do/ /yid kyang chags pa myed do/ /gzugs kyang chags pa myed do/ /sgra yang chags pa myed do/ dri yang chags pa myed do/ /ro yang chags pa myed do/ /reg kyang chags pa ༷myed do/ /chos kyang chags pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /16—170

rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do//lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa skyed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do//sa'i khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /chu'i khams kyang chags pa skyed do/ /mye'i khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /rlung gi khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /ma rig pa yang chags pa myed do/ /'du byed kyang chags pa myed do//rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs kyang chags pa myed do/ /skye mched drug kyang chags pa myed do/ /reg pa yang chags pa myed do / /tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /sred pa yang chags pa myed do/ /len pa yang chags pa myed do/ /srid pa yang chags pa myed do/ /skye ba yang chags pa myed do/ /rga shi yang chags pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin 16—171

pa yang chags pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed dol/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi ①pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid kyang chags pa ②skyed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do//phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do / /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa skyed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang chags pa skyed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang ⑤chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang 16—172

chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang ②chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang chags pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do//ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po yang chags pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /rab 'byor kyis smras pa / tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ②de bzhin te/ gzugs kyang chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /'du shes kyang chags pa myed do//'du byed kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa yang chags pa skyed do/ /myig kyang chags pa myed do/ /rna ba yang chags pa myed do/ /sna yang chags pa myed do/ /lce yang chags pa myed do/ /lus kyang chags pa myed do/ /yid kyang chags pa myed do/ /gzugs kyang chags pa myed do/ /sgra yang chags pa myed do/ /dri yang chags pa myed do/ /ro yang chags pa myed do/ /reg kyang chags pa myed do/ /chos kyang chags pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par 16—173

shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do//sna'i rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg hu)pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /sa'i khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /chu'i khams kyang chags pa skyed do/ /mye'i khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /rlung gi khams kyang chags pa skyed do/ /nam mkha'i khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang chags pa myed do/ /ma rig pa yang chags pa myed do / /'du byed kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa yang chags pa myed do / /mying dang gzugs kyang chags pa myed do/ /skye mched drug kyang chags pa myed do/ /reg pa yang chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba yang chags pa myed do/ /srid pa yang chags pa myed do/ /len pa yang chags pa myed do/ /srid pa yang chags pa myed do/ /skye ba yang chags pa myed do/ /rga shi yang chags pa myed 16—174

do / /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa skyed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang chags pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do / /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyang chags pa skyed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /dor ba myed ni stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do / /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang chags pa myed do / /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang chags pa myed do/ /16—175

'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang ②chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smyon ②pa myed pa yang chags pa skyed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dukyang chags pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang chags pa myed do/ /0snying rje chen po yang chags pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang chags pa med do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang chags pa myed do/ / smras pa 0tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor khyod 0kyis 'di skad du/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems de yang zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do zhes smras pa ⑦ni de lta yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor der yang ma zad de/ byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi sems kyang ⑧rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sems dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rab 'byor kyis smras pa de yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra 16—176

dwa ti'i bu/ byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kyi sems kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa skyed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /nyan thos rnams kyi sems kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sems kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor de lta yin na/gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'du shes kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'du byed kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//myig kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rna ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sna yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lce yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//16—177

sgra yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dri yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ro yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /reg kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /chos kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do / /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa skyed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /16—178

yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa skyed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sa'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /chu'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mye'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rlung gi khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ma rig pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'du byed kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud 16—179

pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /skye mched drug kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//reg ①pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sred pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /len pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /srid pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /skye ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do / /rga shi yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir / zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa skyed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /16—180

nang stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir / zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin ⑨stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa skyed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa med cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dngos po ②16—181

myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang ①rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams ④kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su 16—182

chud pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir①/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs ②su chud pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam ②pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do// //16—183

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bdun ①pa/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu ji skad du smras pa de bzhin te/ gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa med do/ /tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'du shes kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'du byed kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myig kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rna ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sna yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lce yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzugs kyang 3snarang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sgra yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dri yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir / zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ro yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /reg kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /16—184

chos kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ /zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do / /yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa 16—185

myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sa'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /chu'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mye'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rlung gi khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir / zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ma rig pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'du byed kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//mying dang gzugs kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /skye mched drug kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /reg pa yang rang bzhin stong pa 16—186

nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshor ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sred pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /len pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /srid pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /skye ba yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rga shi yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /16—187

stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir / zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa skyed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing 16—188

khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa skyed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa 16—189

myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa skyed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa skyed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /①snying rje chen po yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir / zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do//lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ zag pa myed cing khongs su chud pa myed do/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ②gang yang khyod kyis 'di skad du/sems myed pa'i phyir/ sems de la yang chags pa myed do zhes smras pa ni de lta yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor der yang ma zad de③/ gzugs myed pa yang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed pa yang tshor ba dul chags pa myed do/ /'du shes myed pa yang 'du shes dul chags pa myed do/ /'du byed 16—190

myed pa yang 'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /myig myed pa yang myig la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba myed pa yang rna ba la chags pa myed do/ /sna myed pa yang sna la chags pa myed do/ /lce myed pa yang lce la chags pa myed do/ /lus myed pa yang lus la chags pa myed do/ /yid myed pa yang yid la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa yang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /sgra myed pa yang sgra la chags pa myed do / /dri myed pa yang dri la chags pa myed do/ /ro myed pa yang ro la chags pa myed do/ /reg ⑦skyed pa yang reg la chags pa myed do/ /chos myed pa yang chos la chags pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang myig gi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang sna'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang lce'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang lus kyi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang yid kyi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang sna'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang lce'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do//16—191
