myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa ①las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang sna'i 'dus te reg pa ②las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /sa'i khams myed pa yang sa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /chu'i khams myed pa yang chu'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /mye'i khams myed pa yang mye'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /rlung gi khams skyed pa yang rlung gi khams la chags pa myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams skyed pa yang nam mkha'i khams la chags ①pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed pa yang rnam par shes pa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /ma rig pa myed pa yang ma rig pa la chags pa myed do/ /'du byed myed pa yang 'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do//mying dang gzugs myed pa yang mying dang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /skye mched drug myed pa yang skye mched drug la chags pa myed do/ /reg pa myed pa yang reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed pa yang tshor ba la chags pa myed do / /sred pa myed pa yang sred pa la chags pa myed do/ /len pa myed pa yang 16—192

len pa la chags pa myed do/ /srid pa myed pa yang srid pa la chags pa myed do/ /skye ba myed pa yang skye ba la chags pa myed do/ /rga shi myed pa yang rga shi la chags pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do//bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa skyed do/ /nang stong pa nyid myed pa yang nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed pa yang phyi stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed pa yang phyi nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed pa yang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed pa yang chen po stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang don dam pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed pa yang 'dus byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed pa yang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid med pa yang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 16—193

la chags pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed pa yang rang bzhin stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed pa yang chos thams cad stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed pa yang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do//ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed pa yang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid skyed pa yang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa myed pa yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba myed pa yang yang dag par spong ba rnams ①la chags pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa myed pa yang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /dbang po myed pa yang dbang po rnams la chags pa myed do/ /stobs myed pa yang stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa yang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag ②brgyad pa myed pa yang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa myed pa yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /bsam gtan myed pa yang bsam gtan rnams la chags pa myed do/ /tshad med pa myed pa yang tshad myed pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa myed pa yang gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa ②skyed pa yang rnam par thar pa 16—194

rnams la chags pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa myed pa yang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed pa yang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la chags pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa myed pa yang mngon par shes pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin med pa yang ting nge 'dzin rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo ༷myed pa yang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la chags pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs myed pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa myed pa yang myi 'jigs pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa yang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed pa yang byams pa chen po la chags pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed pa yang snying rje chen po la chags pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa myed pa yang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid med pa yang thams cad shes pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed pa yang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid med pa yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de de bzhin te/ gzugs myed pa yang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed pa yang tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /'du shes myed pa yang 'du shes la chags pa skyed do/ /'du byed skyed pa yang 'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /16—195

rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /myig myed pa yang myig la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba skyed pa yang rna ba la chags pa med do/ /sna myed pa yang sna la chags pa myed do/ /lce myed pa yang lce la chags pa myed do/ /lus med pa yang lus la chags pa myed do/ /yid med pa yang yid la chags pa med do/ /gzugs med pa yang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /sgra myed pa yang sgra la chags pa med do/ /dri myed pa yang dri la chags pa myed do/ /ro myed pa yang ro la chags pa myed do/ /reg med pa yang reg la chags pa med do//chos myed pa yang chos la chags pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang myig gi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa skyed pa yang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang sna'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed pa yang lce'i rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang lus kyi rnam par shes pa la chags pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed pa yang yid kyi rnam par shes pa la chags pa med do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang myig gi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang sna'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang lce'i 'dus te reg pa la chags pa med do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa myed do//yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed pa yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la chags pa med do//myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang myig gi 'dus te reg 16—196

pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa med do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba med pa yang lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa med do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myed pa yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la chags pa myed do/ /sa'i khams med pa yang sa'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /chu'i khams myed pa yang chu'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /mye'i khams myed pa yang mye'i khams la chags pa myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed pa yang rlung gi khams la chags pa ②skyed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed pa yang nam mkha'i khams la chags pa med do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed pa yang rnam par shes pa'i khams la chags pa med do/ /ma rig pa med pa yang ma rig pa la chags pa myed do/ /'du byed myed pa yang 'du byed la chags pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed pa yang rnam par shes pa la chags pa med do//mying dang gzugs med pa yang ming dang gzugs la chags pa myed do/ /skye mched drug myed pa yang skye mched drug la chags pa myed do/ /reg pa myed pa yang reg pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshor ba med pa yang tshor ba la chags pa myed do / /sred pa myed pa yang sred pa la chags pa myed do/ /len pā med pa yang len pa la chags pa myed do/ /srid pa myed pa yang srid pa la chags ②pa myed do//16—197

skye ba myed pa yang skye ba la chags pa myed do/ /rga shi myed pa yang rga shi la chags pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa med pa yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa med pa yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa skyed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do//bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed pa yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skyed pa yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la chags pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid med pa yang nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed pa yang phyi stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed pa yang phyi nang stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid med pa yang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed pa yang chen po stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid med pa yang don dam pa stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid med pa yang 'dus byas stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /'dus ①ma byas stong pa nyid med pa yang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa ②stong pa nyid med pa yang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid myed pa yang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid med pa yang dor ba myed pa ②stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid med pa yang rang 16—198

bzhin stong pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid med pa yang chos thams cad stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid med pa yang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid med pa yang mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la chags pa med do//dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid med pa yang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid med pa yang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid med pa yang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa med pa yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /yang dag par spong ba med pa yang yang dag par spong ba rnams la chags pa med do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi spyirkang pa myed pa yang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /dbang po med pa yang dbang po rnams la chags pa med do/ /stobs med pa yang stobs rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag myed pa yang byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la chags pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed pa yang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag rnams ②la chags pa med do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa med pa yang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /bsam gtan med pa yang bsam gtan rnams la chags pa med do/ /tshad med pa ②med pa ④yang tshad med pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa med pa yang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /rnam par thar pa med pa yang rnam par thar pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa med 16wa 199

pa yang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa ①myed pa yang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la chags pa med do/ /mngon par shes pa med pa yang mngon par shes pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin med pa yang ting nge 'dzin rnams la chags pa med do/ /gzungs kyi sgo med pa yang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la chags pa med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs med pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la chags pa med do/ /myi 'jigs pa myed pa yang mi 'jigs pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa myed pa yang so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la chags pa myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed pa yang byams pa chen po la chags pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed pa yang snying rje chen po la chags pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa med pa yang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la chags pa med do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid med pa yang thams cad shes pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /lam gyi rnam pa zhushes pa nyid med pa yang lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid la chags pa med do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed pa yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la chags pa myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni byang chub kyi sems mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sems/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ④ma yin pa'i sems des kyang chos thams cad la dmyigs pa myed pa'i tshul gyis rlom sems su 'gyur ba 16—200

myed② / mngon par chags par 'gyur ba med pas de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa byams gang gi bus / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das don gang gi slad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba de la bdag kyang spobs pa skye'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang po khyod kyis spobs pa skyed cig /gang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni go cha chen po bgos pa'i sems can lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i sems can lags laphusna/ de ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa'i sems can lags pas/ de'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' dusems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa byams gang gi bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po ci 5tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos go cha shechen po khyabagos zhes bya/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i khyazhig gi don du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing /sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i duphyir/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing /tshul khrims srung ba ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing tshul khrims srung ngo / /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i 0phyir/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bzod pa sgom pa 16—201

ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / bzod pa sgom mo/ /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i ①phyir/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / brtson 'grus rtsom pa ma yin gyi / sems can thams cad kyi don tu brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i ②phyir/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bsam gtan skyed pa ma yin gyi / sems can thams cad kyi don du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / bsam gtan skyed do/ /sems can nyung zad nyi tse'i ②phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / shes rab sgom pa ma yin gyi/sems can thams cad kyi don tu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /shes rab sgom mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can 'di snyed cig phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las bzla rngubar bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni yongs su mya ngan las bzla gebar myi bya'o zhe'am/ sems can 'di snyed cig ni byang chub tu dgod par bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni byang chub tu dgod par mi bya'o zhes sems can yongs su dpag nyepas go cha mi gyon gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad kyi don du go cha chen po gyon to/ /⑦de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 16—202

la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar ①bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar ②bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang nang stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o / /bdag gis kyang phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang phyi stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o//sems can thams cad kyang chen po stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang 'dus ma byas stong 16—203

pa nyid ①yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis ①kyang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rang bzhin stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang mi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o / /sems can thams cad kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya'o / /sems can thams cad kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 16—204

la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag gis ①kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang yang dag par spong ba bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang yang dag par spong ba bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang dbang po lnga la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang dbang po lnga la sbyar bar bya'o//bdag kyang stobs lnga la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang stobs lnga la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la gnas par bya'o / /sems can thams cad kyang byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la sbyar bar bya'o / /bdag kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la sbyar bar bya'o//bdag kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang bsam gtan rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang bsam gtan rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang tshad myed pa rnams la gnas par bya'o / /sems can thams cad kyang tshad med pa rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang rnam par thar pa brgyad la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rnam par thar pa brgyad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang 16—205

mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ①la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang mngon par shes pa rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang mngon par shes pa rnams la sbyar bar bya'o / /bdag kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ②la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang myi 'jigs pa bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang myi 'jigs pa bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la sbyar bar bya'o/ /①bdag kyang snying rje chen po la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang snying rje chen po la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bdag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la gnas par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes bya bar sems bskyed deX/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go 16—206

cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / sbyin pa gang yongs su gtong ba de dag /nyan thos dang/ rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyis①/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas yongs su gtong ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ②ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing ③/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i don tu yongs su myi sngo ④ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / chos de dag la bzod 0pa dang /mos pa dang / rten pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ rnam pa 16—207

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas brtson 'grus nyam ①par myi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa yongs su gtong ②ba'i tshe 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sems rtse gcig tu byed cing / de la dmyigs pa gcig pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ①pa rnams kyi go mi 'byed pa 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha'o//tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos thams cad sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ des sbyin pa yang mi dmyigs / gtong ba yang myi dmyigs/ len pa yang mi dmyigs pa 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha ste/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ pha rol tu phyin pa de dag la ④mtshan mar mi byed cing mi dmyigs pa de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i go cha chen 16—208

po bgos par shes par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / rnam ①pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa gang yongs su gtong ba de/ sems can thams cad dang thun ②mong du byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yongs su sngo ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la yang mos pa myi skyed zhun/ so so'i skye bo'i sa la lta dusmos kyang mi smos pa 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos de dag la bzod pa dang mos pa dang / rten pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /brtson 'grus nyam 0par mi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems 16—209

dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam ①pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing gnas pa'i tshe/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sems kyi go myi 'byed cing dge ba'i rtsa ba de ②yang / sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / chos thams cad sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas shing / tshul khrims des rlom sems su mi byed de/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ tshul khrims de yang mi dmyigs shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes 16—210

bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i ①yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sbyin pa yongs su gtong ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/ yongs su bsngo ②ba 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims yongs su srung zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / ②rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas chos de ④dag la bzod pa dang / mos pa dang /rten pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang /16—211

rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /brtson 'grus nyam ①par myi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/② bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos thams cad la dusgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ bzod pa des rlom sems su mi byed cing / bzod pa mi dmyigs pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ④bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang ⑤byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 16—212

tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos thams cad la sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ bsam gtan des kyang rlom sems su myi byed cing / bsam gtan de yang mi dmigs te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang / sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen postibasam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su 'dzin te③/ de'i phyir go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang / sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas 16—217

dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ tshul khrims yongs su srung zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/spyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/chos de dag la de ltar bzod pa la mos shing rten ②te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te②/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/④ shis rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bzod rjopa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ brtson 'grus nyam ༅par mi byed cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po meshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang 16—218

ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzhan yang byang chub ①sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas sems rtse gcig tu byed cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po②/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / chos thams cad la sgyu mar byas pa'i 'du shes nye bar gnas te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rlom sems su mi byed de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen poni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag dang / sems can dang / byang chub la mtshan mar myi byed mi dmigs pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi 16—219

go cha chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ①pha rol tu phyin pa re re la gnas shing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ②bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la yang mnyam par gzhog ste/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang /gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ro yang ⑦myong bar myi byed do/ /bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag ④gis kyang mi 'phrogs te⑤/ bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis kyang mi skye'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ༅thabs mkhas pa dang 'grogs pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dag la dben pa ⑦mthong ba dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa mthong bas mnyam par gzhog ste/ de dag gi dbang gis kyang mi skye/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du yang mi byed de/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang zil gyis gnon to②/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 16—220

chen po ①go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po brgyad ②pa/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar dugo cha chen po dubagos pa la shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ⑤klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams ched du brjod pa ched du rjod ducing / ming yongs su sgrog ⑦pa mdzad de/'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su sbyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing / ming yongs su sgrog ⑧pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po ⑨bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su phyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing / mying yongs su sgrog 0 pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su sbyind par byed do/ /16—221

sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su nyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /byang shar kyi phyogs mtshams kyi tshopho'ajig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod 37pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad do/ /thu'ajig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su spyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs snyepa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su phyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs 16—222

rjes su sgrog go/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi ①khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can ②yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad ①cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su sbyind par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 16—223

bzhugs pa rnams kyang ched du brjod pa ched du rjod cing mying yongs su sgrog pa mdzad de/ 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa 'di lta bu zhig sems can yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par rtse'o zhes sgra rjod pa mdzad cing dbyangs rjes su sgrog go/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po ci ①tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs zhes bya/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang yin/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod de/ de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben ②sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa / rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa①/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs rjote gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang ①snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas 16—224

so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal ba ①yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang ②snyoms dang dran pas ①bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs ༅skyed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/⑤ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa shin tu bsgoms pas/'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas ༷shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten ④chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas / 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa / stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i 16—225

phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi ①'du shes yid la mi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' ②yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' ①mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs ①te gnas so//de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te / chung 0zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs yite gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par ⑦'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas soni/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad myed pa 'di dag dang / gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam pa dang /tshul dang / mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing / rnam par ①ldang ba'i tshe yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam 16—226

gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang /rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod pa myed pa'i ⑨ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas/dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang ②snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/sdug bsngal ②yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i 16—227

sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas / 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs ①pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi ②'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' ①mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/cung ༅zad ma yod de ⑤zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems 16—228

dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad myed pa 'di dag dang /gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam pa dang tshul dang /mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang ba'i tshe yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so / /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa / rnam par dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang ①snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par spyod ②pa btang snyoms pa'o/ /zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing /yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang ②snyoms dang ༷dran pas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/16—229

gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa smyod pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas / 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs ①pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing / rnam par spyod do//de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi/ dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i ②mthas gtugs pa'i/ phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing / rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems/ rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi/ dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas/ gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu/ rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing / rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis btang ①snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa④/ shin tu bsgoms ⑤pas 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams 16—230

cad du ① nam mkha' khyamatha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad med pa'i saskye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad myed pa 'di dag dang / gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam ④pa dang /tshul dang / mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang ba'i tshe yang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa / dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs ⑤te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran 76—231

pa dang ldan zhing / shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis ①myang la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa②/ bde ba la rnam par spyod ②pa/ btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs ④te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs / sdug bsngal yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang dusnyoms dang yidran pas bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pasal/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs ⑦pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms ⑧pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis btang 16—232

snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /hu)de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' ②mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' ①mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam ④shis mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad med pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad myed pa 'di dag dang / gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam pa dang / tshul dang / mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang ba'i tshe yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 16—233

'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas rnam par rtog pa skyed pa/ rnam par dpyod ①pa myed pa ②ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing / shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis dumyong la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang dusnyoms pa'o/ /zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal duyang spangs shing /yid bde ba dang / yid mi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/sdug bsngal ⑥yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/⑦ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/16—234

tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis ①klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po / shin tu yangs pa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas / 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis ⑤klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing / rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis btang ①snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched 16—235

la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin stiskye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ②bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad myed pa 'di dag dang / gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam pa dang /tshul dang / mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang ba'i tshe yang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas/ dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang ②snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis dhimyong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par spyod dupa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de ⑥bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal ⑦16—236

yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal ①yang skyed pa/ btang ②snyoms dang dran pas bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs ②skyed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/gcugs duskyed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad skyed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis 0klas padu/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam 16—237

par spyod do/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi ①'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' ②mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' sematha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan te/ nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan 'di dag dang / tshad med pa 'di dag dang / gzugs myed pa na yod pa 'di dag la nam mkha'i rnam pa dang / tshul dang / mtshan mas mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang ba'i tshe yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs dupa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad 16—238

myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis 0klas pa / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par ②byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de snying rje dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/shin tu yangs ②pa/ myi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa 0skyed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas / 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de dga' ba dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs dupa/ myi gnyis pa / tshad myed pa/ gcugs myed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa / yongs su rdzogs pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis tshuklas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems rgya chen po/ shin tu yangs dupa/ mi gnyis pa/ tshad myed pa/gcugs duskyed pa/ gnod pa myed pa/ stod pa myed pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/shin tu bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten chos kyi ⑨dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam 6) mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste/ mos ⑩par byas shing rnam par spyod do/ /de 'dod pas dben/ sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog ⑩pa dang / rnam par dpyod 0pa nye 16—239

bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rnam par rtog pa myed pa/ rnam par dpyod ①pa myed pa/ ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs ②te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la/'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par spyod ②pa btang bsnyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang / yid mi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' spriyas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te / chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes skyed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la du16—240

nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas / nyon mongs pa rab tu spangs pa'i ①phyir/ bsam gtan dang /tshad myed pa dang / gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gzhan la ②rjod cing 'chad pa dang / ston cing 'grel ①la rnam par 'byed cing gsal bar byed de/ de dag gi 0ro dang / de dag gi skyon dang / 'byung ba yang tshul bzhin du ston pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba de dag gis/bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag la mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang yang 'di lta stebya/nyan thos sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi yang durung ste/ sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi go mi 'byed pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma nyams pa'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas / bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis rnam par spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di snyam ste/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zad par bya ba'i phyir chos bstan meto/ /snyam du sems shing yid la bya ba de dag la bzod pa dang / mos pa dang / rtog pa dang / sems shing khong du chud par byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' 16—241

sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis rnam par spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyi don dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi phyir/ brtson 'grus nyam ①par mi byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar ②pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dudang /snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang yang /nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar myi ltung ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag rjodang /bsam gtan gnyis pa'i yan lag ⑤dang / bsam gtan gsum pa'i yan lag medang / bsam gtan bzhi pa'i yan lag medang / byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / chung zad myed pa'i skye mched dang / 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched de dag myi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag myed pa'i rnam pa dang /zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa'i rnam pa dang / mtshan ma myed pa'i rnam pa 16—242

dang / smon pa myed pa'i rnam par rab tu rtog kyang bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms ①par 'jug pa de dag myi dmyigs shing / de dag gis rlom sems myed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste④/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ rnam pa thams cad du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi sgom pa dang /rnam pa thams cad du yang dag par spong ba bzhi sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du dbang po lnga sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du stobs lnga sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du byang chub kyi yan lag bdun sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du bsam gtan rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du tshad myed pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rnam par thar pa rnams sgom pa dang /rnam pa thams cad du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du mngon par shes pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du ting nge 'dzin 16—243

rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du gzungs kyi sgo rnams 7sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams ②cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du mi 'jigs pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du byams pa chen po sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du snying rje chen po sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du thams cad shes pa nyid sgom pa dang /rnam pa thams cad du lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid sgom pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sgom pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o / /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhog cing /bdag gis sems can thams cad yongs su bskyab par bya'o zhes de la gzhol bar byed do/ /snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam dupar gzhog cing / sems can rnams ⑤la snying rje ba dang / snying brtse ba'i nyams su byed do/ /dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhog cing / bdag nyid kyis dgrol bar bya'o zhes sems can rnams la sems so/ /btang snyoms kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhog cing / sems can rnams kyi duzag pa zad ⑦par bya ba la rab tu gzhol bar byed del/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa rnams 16—244

kyi rnam pa dang / tshul dang / mtshan ma la mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bsngo ①ba ma gtogs par nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su mi sngo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su ma nyams ②pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad skyed pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis ma 'dres par nirnam par spyod cing / sa gnyis po nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar 'dod pa myi skyed kyi/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mos shing dga' ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas④/ myi dge ba'i chos rnams rab tu spang ba ⑤dang / dge ba'i chos phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i don du / brtson 'grus myi gtong bas rnam par spyod pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms ⑥par 'jug pa 'di dag la yang mnyam par gzhog la/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms ⑦par 'jug ⑧pa'i dbang gis kyang myi skye zhing /de dag gi ro myong bar byed pa yang myed la/ de dag gis 'phrogs par yang mi 'gyur ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad myed pa 16—245
