rnams la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /nam byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas/ bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag la yang mnyam par gzhog cing rnam par ldang la/de dag la myi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag myed pa'i rnam pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa'i rnam pa dang /mtshan ma myed pa'i rnam pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i rnam par rab tu rtog kyang /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi skyon myed par yang ①'jug par myi byed pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ⑤ tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa'ini/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dutheg pa chen po ni/ nang stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dum yin/phyi stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ chen po stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin / 'dus byas stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ dor ba 16—246

myed pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes kyang dmigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid shes kyang dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ma yin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni / chos thams cad la sems rnam par myi 'khrug ①cing mnyam par gzhag ②par shes pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni rtag ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug /myi rtag ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / bde zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug /sdug bsngal zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / bdag ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug /bdag myed ②ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / sdug ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug /myi sdug ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa chadang / stong zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug myi stong zhes bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang / mtshan ma yod ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug mtshan ma myed ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa dang /16—247

smon pa yod ces bya bar shes pa ①phyi 'jug smon pa myed ces bya bar shes pa myi 'jug pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang 'das pa'i dus la shes pa myi 'jug ma 'ongs pa'i dus la shes pa myi 'jug da ltar gyi dus la shes pa 'jug par myi byed de/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi dus myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'di la 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi dus myi shes pa yang med pa sa②ste/tshobatshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di ni de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ④byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/ ⑤'dod pa'i khams su shes pa 'jug par mi byed/ gzugs dang gzugs myed pa'i khams su shes pa 'jug par myi byed la/ 'dod pa dang /gzugs dang gzugs myed pa'i khams myi shes pa yang myed pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni/'jig rten pa'i chos la yang shes pa 'jug par myi byed 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa myed pa dang / 'dus byas kyi chos dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos la shes pa 'jug par myi byed kyang / 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos myi shes pa yang myed/ zag pa dang 16—248

bcas pa dang zag pa myed pa dang / 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyang mi shes pa myed pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di yang de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ①byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po ci gtsam gyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gatheg pa chen po la gnas zhes byabya/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang des sbyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/len pa yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang / des tshul khrims kyang myi dmyigs/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang / des bzod pa yang 16—249

myi dmyigs/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang mi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang mi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang / des brtson 'grus kyang myi dmyigs/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang mi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/yid la bya ba ①de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas shes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang /des bsam gtan yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs / byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas shes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas kyang / des bodage ba'i chos kyang myi dmyigs shing ②/ mi dge ba dang / 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 16—250

'das pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa'i chos kyang myi dmyigs shing sa①shes rab kyang myi dmyigs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang myi dmyigs/ yid la bya ba de dag kyang myi dmyigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas shes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis phyi nang stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chen po stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres 16—251

pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus byas stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang bzhin stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom 16—252

pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid sgom mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par spong ba bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dbang po lnga sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres ①pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis stobs lnga bsgom ②mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub kyi yan lag ①bdun sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 16—253

dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bsam gtan bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres ①pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshad myed pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs myed pa'i snyoms ②par 'jug pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par thar pa brgyad sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ①stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa ④sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis mngon par shes pa 16—254

rnams sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis gzungs kyi sgo rnams sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu sgom mo / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas/ bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis myi 'jigs pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de myi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis so so yang dag par rig ①pa bzhi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis snying rje chen po sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par bsgom pa'i don du/ de mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad sgom mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ②chen pos/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' dmyigs su med pa'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni 16—255

tha snyad tsam du zad do zhes bya bar shes so/ /gzugs dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir gzugs zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir / tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'du shes dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'du shes zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'du byed dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir 'du byed ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myig dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myig ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rna ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sna dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sna zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lce dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir lce zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lus dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lus zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /gzugs dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sgra dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dri dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dri zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ro dmyigs su skyed pa'i phyir/ ro zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /reg dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/reg ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos dmyigs su med pa'i phyir/chos zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i 16—256

rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i 'dus 16—257

te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sa'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sa'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chu'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chu'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mye'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/mye'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rlung gi khams dmyigs lasu myed pa'i phyir/ rlung gi khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /nam mkha'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ nam mkha'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/rnam par shes pa'i khams zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ma rig pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'du byed dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'du byed ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par shes pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mying dang gzugs dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/mying dang gzugs shes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /skye mched drug dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ skye mched drug ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do//16—258

reg pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ reg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/tshor ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do//sred pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sred pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do//len pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ len pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do//srid pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ srid pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do//skye ba dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ skye ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do//rga shi dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rga shi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /bsam gtan gyi 1)pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do//nang stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /phyi stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ phyi stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /16—259

stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad chodo/ /chen po stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chen po stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir / 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su med pa'i phyir/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ngo bo nyid 16—260

stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba 17'di ni pying tsam du zad do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /dbang po rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ dbang po lnga zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /stobs rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ stobs lnga zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rgyalam dudamyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do / /bsam gtan rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /tshad myed pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir / tshad myed pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa brgyad 16—261

ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams dmyigs su skyed pa'i phyir/ mngon par shes pa zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ gzungs kyi sgo zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do//de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /so so yang dag par rig 〉pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /snying rje chen po dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ snying rje chen po zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi 3chos ma 'dres pa rnams dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /de bzhin nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dmyigs su myed ②pa'i phyir/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /gzhan ma yin pa 16—262

de bzhin nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos kyi dbyings dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos kyi gnas nyid dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos kyi gnas nyid ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /chos skyon myed pa ①dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ chos skyon myed pa ②zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /byang chub dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub ces bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /sangs rgyas dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas shes bya ba 'di ni mying tsam du zad do/ /zhes bya bar yang dag par shes te/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas zhes bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po dgu ①pa/tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems dang po bskyed pa ④nas snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du mngon par shes pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas shing / sems can yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ⑤la/ mchod pa dang / rim gror bya ba'i tshul gang la gang du'os pa de dag gis/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la rim gror bya ba dang / bkur ster ④bya ba dang /phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas 16—263

kyi zhing du 'gro'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las kyang 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa 'di nyid kyi chos nyan to/ /de byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa de la gnas te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed/ sems can rnams ①yongs su spyin par byed kyang / de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'du shes kyang myi 'byung / sems can gyi 'du shes kyang myi 'byung / sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes kyang myi 'byung ngo / /de gnyis su myed pa'i sa la gnas shing / lus ji lta bus sems can rnams kyi don bya ba'i mthu yod pa de lta bu'i lus ched du bsams shing dugeyongs su 'dzin te②/ de nam rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par ma gyur gyi bar du/ theg pa de dang nam du yang myi 'bral te/des rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob nas kyang / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po dang / myi dang ④phyi ma yin pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bskor bar myi nus pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor ⑤ra/ /de bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang yiyon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad 16—264

mkhyen pa ①nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba ②byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs su rjod ①pa mdzad do/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang / chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba byabyed do/ /zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs ⑤su rjod pa mdzad do/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan brjod ⑥pa mdzad cing 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i ⑦mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang / chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba ⑧byed do zhes/ grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs ⑨su rjod pa mdzad do/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi ⑩byi ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs 0pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba phonyebyed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing 16—265

dbyangs ①su rjod pa mdzad do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan larjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i dumachog la gnas pa 'edi zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba 0byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs dusu rjod pa mdzad do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi ⑦'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs ⑧pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i ⑨mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba 0byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs 0su rjod pa mdzad do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i tsomachog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba 0byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs tustesu rjod pa mdzad do/ /nub byang gi tunyephyogs 16—266

mtshams ①kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba ②byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs ②su rjod pa mdzad do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po/ bla na myed pa'i theg pa/theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba dubyed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs dusu rjod pa mdzad do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed yidag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyang ⑦yon tan rjod pa mdzad cing /'jig rten gyi khams che ge mo zhig tuX/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po/0 bla na myed pa'i theg pa/ theg pa'i mchog la gnas pa 'di zhes bya ba zhig rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba 0byed do zhes grags pa sgrog cing dbyangs 7su rjod pa mdzad do/ /de ltar na tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang 16—267

dag par gnas zhes bya'o/ / de nas ①tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das go cha chen po bgos sol/ /go cha chen po bgos so ②zhes bgyi na/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos zhes bgyi ba lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po'i go cha gyon cing 'di lta ste/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ nang stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ 'dus ma byas ③stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ chos thams cad stong 0nyid kyi go cha bgos / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa 16—268

nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i go cha bgos/ yang dag par spong ba'i go cha bgos/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i go cha bgos/ dbang po'i go cha bgos / stobs kyi go cha bgos/ byang chub kyi yan lag gi go cha bgos/lam gyi go cha bgos/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i go cha bgos/ bsam gtan gyi go cha bgos/ tshad myed pa'i go cha bgos/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i go cha bgos/ rnam par thar pa'i go cha bgos/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i go cha bgos/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i go cha bgos/ mngon par shes pa'i go cha bgos/ ting nge 'dzin gyi go cha bgos/ gzungs ①kyi sgo'i go cha bgos/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi go cha bgos/ myi 'jigs pa'i go cha bgos/ so so yang dag par rig pa'i go cha bgos/ snying rje chen po'i go cha bgos/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad kyi go cha bgos / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i go cha bgos nas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ②'di snang bas rgyas par bkang ste/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 16—269

'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bas rgyas par 'gengs so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod do/ /①shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod ②do/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod ②do/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig 0rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod ⑤do/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod yido/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod ⑦do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod ⑧do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod 6)do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod ⑨ do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod yido/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnam pa drug tu rab tu skyod 8do/ /des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 16—270

na① / sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba ②pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ①ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang ༷de dag tu skye'o/ /des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ byol song gi skye gnas kyi sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas kyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang duzhi bar byas te/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dul phyag 'tshal lo zhes ④bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas kyi sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ⑧ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/ byol song gi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par langs nas lasangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o / /des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na4) /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sems can rnams kyi gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin 16—271

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de ①la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sems can de dag kyang ②sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag zhugashin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang ④de dag tu skye'o/ /des shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba ⑤pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/ sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o / /des lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de ⑥la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos 16—272

nas dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ①ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o / /des nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba ②pa'i ①sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas/ rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad med par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de ④la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/ sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi 16—273

zhing gang dang gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de ①la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de rgyal phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog ①go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ④ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na⑤/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs 0shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o / /des lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi 16—274

bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de 'tshal phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba phyapa'i dusems can de dag kyang /sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de tsho la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog phyego/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par ⑥byas te/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de ⑦la 16—275

phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na①/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig ②ten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/sems can dmyal ba'i mye'i phung po ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad myed par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de ②la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas / dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/sems can dmyal ba de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag sems can dudamyal ba de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye ⑤gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas 16—276

dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ①ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi ②sdug bsngal/ ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog ①go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang /sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ④ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs 0shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i / sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig 16—277

rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ①ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ②ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de 16—278

dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ①ste / de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song ②gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams ②kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe dubyol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sanges rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song gi skye 16—279

gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ①ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang /② gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra 16—280

rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ①ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /②de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs dunas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas/ dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na④/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /des steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byol song gi skye gnas dang/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi byol song 16—281

gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad zhi bar byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod do/ /dbyangs sgrog go/ /de'i tshe byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas dga' ba dang bde ba 'thob ①ste/ de dag dga' ba dang bde ba des byol song gi skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par ldang ngo / /de dag byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dang de dag tu skye'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na / sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/0 sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan ③bu mkhas pa zhig gis ④lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi ⑤mdun du sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten yidag cig memangon par sprul la/ de ltar mngon par sprul nas/ ngan song gi sems can de dag la sangs rgyas kyi sgra sgrog /chos kyi sgra sgrog /dge 'dun gyi sgra sgrog par gyur dul/ de nas sprul pa de dag sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang /chos kyi sgra dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra des sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de dag nas rnam par langs par gyur shin/ rab 'byor de ⑩la ⑩ci 8snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po dang /sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu des sems can gang yang sems can dmyal ba dang /byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten de tsonas rnam par bslang 16—282

ba yod dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad myed grangs myed pa'i sems can rnams ngan song gsum las yongs su bkrol yang sems can gang yang yongs su grol ①bar byas pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na②/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po ②bgos pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams be+e ḍūr+ya'i durgyu las byung ba mngon par sprul pa 0byed do/ /de ltar bai ḍūd+ma'i durgyu las byung ba mngon par sprul nas/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i srid ⑦mngon par sprul pa byed do/ /de ltar 'khor los dusgyur ba'i srid mngon par sprul nas/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas kyi sbyin pa byed do/ /skom 'dod pa rnams la skom gyi sbyin pa byed do/ /bzhin pa 'dod pa rnams la bzhin pa'i sbyin pa byed do/ /gos 'dod pa rnams la gos kyi sbyin pa byed do/ /me tog 'dod pa rnams la me tog gi sbyin pa byed do/ /phreng ba 'dod pa rnams la phreng ba'i sbyin pa byed do/ /spos 'dod pa rnams la spos kyi sbyin pa byed do/ /byug pa 'dod pa rnams la byug pa'i sbyin pa byed do/ /mal cha 'dod pa rnams ⑨la mal cha'i sbyin pa byed do//khyim 'dod pa rnams la khyim gyi sbyin pa byed do/ /'tsho ba 'dod pa rnams la 'tsho ba'i sbyin pa byed do/ /yo byad 'dod pa rnams la yo byad kyi sbyin pa byed do//16—283

nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad 'dod pa rnams la nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad kyi sbyin pa byed do/ /nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūrla dang / dung dang /man shel dang / byi ①ru dang / gser zhudangul 'dod pa rnams la/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang /byi ①ru dang / gseradu/ dngul gyi sbyin pa byed pa nas/ myi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du sbyin pa byed de/ des de ltar zas 'dod pa rnams ⑤la zas byin/ skom 'dod pa rnams dul skom byin/ bzhon ⑦pa 'dod pa rnams ⑧la bzhon ⑨pa byin/ gos 'dod pa la gos byin/0 me tog 'dod pa yil me tog byin/ phreng ba 'dod pa la phreng ba byin/ spos 'dod pa la spos byin/byug pa 'dod pa la byug pa byin/ mal cha 'dod pa la mal cha byin/ khyim 'dod pa la khyim byin/ 'tsho ba 'dod pa la 'tsho ba byin/ yo byad 'dod pa la yo byad byin/ nad kyi 0rkyen rtsi dang yo byad 'dod pa rnams tsol ni tsond kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad byin/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang /dung dang / man shel dang / byi 7ru dang / gser dngul 'dod pa rnams ⑩la nipho sna/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūrla dang / dung dang /man shel dang / byi 8ru dang / gser dngul byin pa nas/ myi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du byin nas/ sems can de dag la 'di lta ste/pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di yinyid kyi chos ston 0to/ /sems can de dag gis kyang chos bstan ⑥pa de thos nas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang nam yang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu 16—284

ma'i mkhan po'am sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i ①mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis ②lam po che'i bzhi mdor ③'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/ zas 'dod pa rnams la ni zas byin/ skom 'dod pa rnams la ni skom byin/ bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la ni bzhon pa byin/gos 'dod pa rnams la ni gos byin/ me tog 'dod pa rnams la ni me tog byin/phreng ba 'dod pa rnams la ni phreng ba byin/ spos 'dod pa rnams la ni spos byin/byug pa 'dod pa rnams la ni byug pa byin/ mal cha 'dod pa rnams la ni mal cha byin/ khyim 'dod pa rnams la ni khyim byin/ 'tsho ba 'dod pa rnams la ni 'tsho ba dubyin/ yo byad 'dod pa rnams la ni yo byad byin/ nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad 'dod pa rnams la ni nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad byin/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ⑤ru dang / gser dngul 'dod pa rnams la ni/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang /be+e ḍūrla dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi yiru dang / gser dngul byin pa nas/ mi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du byin na/ rab 'byor de la ci snyam ⑦du sems sgyu ma'i mkhan po 'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu des sems can gang la yang ci yang byin pa yod dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal dusrid khyamangon par sprul te/ zas 'dod pa rnams la ni zas byin/skom 'dod pa rnams la ni 0skom byin/ bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la ni bzhon pa byin/ gos 'dod pa rnams la ni gos byin/ me tog 'dod pa rnams la ni 16—285

me tog byin/ phreng ba 'dod pa rnams la ①ni phreng ba byin/ spos 'dod pa rnams la ni spos byin/ byug pa 'dod pa rnams la ni byug pa byin/ mal cha 'dod pa rnams ②la ni mal cha byin/ khyim 'dod pa rnams la ni khyim byin/'tsho ba 'dod pa rnams la ni 'tsho ba byin/ yo byad 'dod pa rnams la ni yo byad byin/ nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad 'dod pa rnams la ni/ nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad byin/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang /dung dang / man shel dang / byi ①ru dang / gser dngul 'dod pa rnams la ni④/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / dung dang /man shel dang / byi ⑤ru dang / gser dngul byin pa nas myi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du byin yang me/ sems can gang la yang ci yang byin pa myed do / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin ⑦pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ⑧ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o//rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ༅tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / ched du bsams tho )te skye ba yongs su bzung bas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs su skye zhing de 'khor los sgyur ⑩ba'i dbang phyug de la gnas nas8/ sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu 'god do/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms hu)par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang 16—286

chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs ①kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad la sems can rnams rab tu 'god de②/ sems can de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas par ma gyur gyi bar du chos bstan pa de dang nam yang 'bral ①bar myi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan 0bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/⑤ skye bo mang po'i tshogs zhig dumangon par sprul te/sems can de dag dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod ⑦dam/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang /yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa 16—287

bzhi dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi ༅sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la sems can rnams rab tu bkod men/ rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po 'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu des sems can gang yang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod ①pa yod dam/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad ④dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la bkod pa yod dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can tshad med grangs med pa dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod de/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi 16—288

dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad la bkod kyang / sems can gang yang de dag la bkod pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i ①phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor zhing rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing ②/sems can thams cad bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor zhing rab tu 'god pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ brgya la sems can thams cad 16—289

bdag la rdo ①dang / dbyig pas rdeg ②cing mtshon gyis 'debs kyang de la bdag gis 'khrug pa'i sems 'ga' tsam yang bskyed par myi bya'o zhes go cha bgo ba ②byed cing / sems can thams cad kyang bzod pa de 'dra ba la rab tu 'god pa byabyed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul tel/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor ⑤ba dang / rab tu 'god par dubyas na/ rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu des sems can gang yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gzhag pa yod dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ sems can tshad med grangs med pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod kyang / sems can gang yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis ⑦de bzhin pa'i phyir te / rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sems can thams cad brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul nizhing gzhog go 'god do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sems can 16—290

thams cad brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul ba dang gzhog cing 'god pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas/ sems can thams cad lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la yang dag par skul zhing gzhog go 'god do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te/ lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la bkod na/rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu des sems can gang yang lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la bkod pa yod dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can tshad med grangs med pa lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la bkod kyang / sems can gang yang lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus la bkod pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po ①bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par ②skul zhing gzhog go 'god do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 16—291

po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te①/ sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul ba dang / gzhog cing 'god pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi chos nyid la gnas shing / chos gang la yang 'khrug pa 'am / 'khrug pa med par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong na/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa yin te/ de de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul zhing gzhog pa dang 'god par byas te②/ de ltar yang dag par skul ba rnams kyang /nam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas par ma gyur gyi bar du nam yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'bral ①bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod na/ rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po 'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu des sems can gang yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa yod dam/gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ④sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod kyang /sems can gang yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na ⑤chos 16—292

rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i ①byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sems can thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul zhing gzhog go 'god do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sems can thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul ba dang / gzhog cing 'god pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos gang yang skye ba'am/ 'gag pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba'am/ tshu rol tam/ pha rol tu myi dmyigs te / rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa yin te/ de de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul zhing gzhog go 'god do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor 'dug ste/skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi mdun du/ skye bo mang po'i tshogs shig mngon par sprul te / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par bskul te bzhag ②cing bkod ①na/ rab 'byor de la ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po'am④/sgyu ma'i mkhan po'i mchan bu des sems can gang yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa yod dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis so/ /16—293

bcom ldan 'das kyis ②bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod kyang / sems can gang yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid kyis de bzhin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos shing / shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / ji ltar bdag sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sems can ji snyed cig 'khod (kyepa de dag thams cad kyang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul zhing gzhog go 'god do/ /ji ltar bdag tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na/sems can ji snyed cig 'khod ③pa de dag thams cad kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul zhing gzhog go 'god do/ /ji ltar bdag bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na/ sems can ji snyed cig 'khod ④pa de dag thams cad kyang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul zhing gzhog go 'god do/ /ji ltar bdag brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa de bzhin du/'jig rten gyi khams de dag na/ sems can ji snyed cig 'khod ⑤pa de dag thams cad kyang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul 16—294
