bcings ma grol ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur byed do//ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i chos nyan to/ /ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i mngon par shes pa rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i myig lnga dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ro//ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i gzungs rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ①ba'i ting nge 'dzin rnams dang nam yang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid sgrub par 'gyur ro/ /ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor ②bar 'gyur ro/ /ma bcings ma grol ba de ma bcings ma grol ba'i sems can rnams theg pa gsum la rab tu 'god par 'gyur te/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma bcings ma grol ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po ma bcings ma grol bas gamyed pa dang / dben pa dang / skye ba myed pa nye bar bzung zhing /chos thams cad khong du chud par byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma bcings ma grol ba/ theg pa chen po'i go ca dubagos par rig par bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 16—352

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang lags bcom ldan 'das ci ①tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs par rig par bgyi ba lags/ theg pa de ni gang nas byung ba lags/ theg pa de ni gang du gnas par 'gyur ②ba lags / theg pa des ni su zhig 'byung bar 'gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor gang khyod de ②skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po gang zhes zer ba ni/ rab 'byor pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ste/drug gang zhe na/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam ④pa thams can mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya bas don du gnyer ba rnams la 'di ltar phyi nang gi dngos po'i sbyin pa yongs su gtong ste/de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yongs su sngo ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dutshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam 16—353

pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas/ bdag kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs shing gnas la/ sems can pha rol kyang ①dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par skul ba dang / gzhog pa dang / rab tu dgod par ②byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su ma nyams pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ①pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas/bdag kyang bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin la/ gzhan yang myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis bzod pa la yang dag par skul ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas bdag kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la brtson pa myi 'dor zhing / gzhan yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sbyor ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems 16—354

dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdag kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas/ bsam gtan rnams la thabs mkhas par ①mnyam par ②gzhog kyang / de dag gi dbang gis myi skye zhing gzhan yang bsam gtan rnams la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par skul ba byed pa 'di ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o//gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed dupas/ bdag kyang chos thams cad la ④mngon par chags pa myed par chos thams cad kyi ⑤rang bzhin yang dmyigs pa myed pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par byed cing / sems can rnams kyang chos thams cad la mngon par chags pa myed pa dang / chos thams cad kyi ⑥rang bzhin rtogs par bya ba la myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par skul zhing gzhog pa dang / rab tu dgod par ⑦byed pa 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de ni rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma 16wa 355

dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid de①/ de la nang stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ nang gi ②chos zhes bya ba ni/ myig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid de/ de la myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ myig myig gis stong stel/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir④/ rna ba rna bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ sna snas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir / lce lces stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ lus lus kyis stong te⑤/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir / yid yid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni nang stong pa nyid ces bya'o0/ /de la phyi stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ phyi'i chos zhes bya ba ni/ gzugs dang sgra dang / dri dang ro dang / reg dang chos rnams te/ de la myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/gzugs gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ sgra sgras stong te⑦/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i 16—356

phyir / dri dris stong stel/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ ro ros stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ reg reg gis stong ste de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ chos chos kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni phyi stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la phyi nang stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ nang gi skye mched drug dang / phyi'i skye mched drug dang / 'di dag ni phyi nang gi chos zhes bya ②ste/ de la myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ nang gi chos rnams phyi'i ②chos kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi'i chos rnams nang gi chos kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ chos rnams kyi ④stong pa nyid gang yin pa'i stong pa nyid des⑤/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yices bya'o/ /de la chen po stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir shar phyogs shar phyogs kyis stong ⑦/ lho phyogs lho phyogs kyis stong ⑤/ nub phyogs nub phyogs kyis stong ⑨/ byang phyogs byang phyogs kyis stong ⑩/ 'og gi phyogs 'og gi phyogs kyis stong / steng gi phyogs steng gi phyogs kyis stong / de bzhin du phyogs mtshams rnams 7phyogs mtshams rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni chen po stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /tsho 16—357

de la don dam pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ don dam pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa ste / myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ mya ngan las 'das pa de yang mya ngan las 'das pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/'di ni don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la 'dus byas stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ 'dus byas zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs myed pa'i khams te/ de la myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/'dod pa'i khams 'dod pa'i khams kyis stong ngo / /gzugs kyi khams gzugs kyi khams kyis stong ngo / /gzugs med pa'i khams gzugs myed pa'i khams kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/'di ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ 'dus ma byas shes bya ba ni gang la skye ba myed pa dang/ 'gag pa myed pa dang / gnas pa las gzhan du 'gyur ba myed pa 'di ni 'dus ma byas zhes bya ste/ myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas de ni 'dus ma byas kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/'di ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la mtha' myi dmyigs pa de ni mtha' las 'das pa ste/myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa mtha' las 'das pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la thog ma dang tha ma ༷myed pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la thog ma myi dmyigs shing / tha ma yang myi dmyigs pa de la 'gro ba myi dmyigs 'ong ba yang myi dmyigs te/ myi rtag myi 16—358

'jig pa'i phyir/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa thog ma dang tha ma myed pas stong ngo //de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni thog ma dang tha ma laphyed pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la gang yang dor ba myed pa ste/ myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ dor ba myed pa ②dor ba myed pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la rang bzhin stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas kyang rung ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni/ nyan thos rnams kyis ma byas/ rang sangs rgyas rnams ②kyis ma byas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ④ma byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma byas te/ myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin rang bzhin kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la chos thams cad stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ chos thams cad ces bya ba ni/gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / myig dang rna ba dang / sna dang lce dang / lus dang yid dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang dri dang / ro dang reg dang / chos dang /myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam — par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / myig gi ⑤'dus te reg pa dang /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te 16—359

reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi ①'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang /gzugs yod pa'i chos dang / gzugs myed pa'i chos dang / 'dus byas kyi chos dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos te②/ 'di dag ni chos thams cad ces bya'ol/ /de la myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad chos thams cad kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/'di ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gzugs ni 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid/ tshor ba ni myong ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'du shes ni 'dzin pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'du byed ni mngon par 'du byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam par shes pa ni rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/phung po ni sdug bsngal ba'i dumatshan nyid/ khams ni gdug pa'i mtshan nyid/ skye mched ni skye ba'i sgo'i mtshan nyid/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ni 'du 'phrod kyi mtshan nyid/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni yongs su gtong ba'i mtshan nyid/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yongs su gdung ba myed pa'i mtshan nyid/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'tshig pa myed pa'i mtshan nyid/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni thub pa myed pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yang dag par 'dus pa'i mtshan nyid/ shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chags pa myed pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed 16—360

pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par ①'jug pa rnams ni 'khrug pa myed pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun ni 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid ni dben pa'i mtshan nyid/rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma myed pa ni ②zhi ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa myed pa ni sdug bsngal sel ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam par grol ba ni rnam par 'grel ①ba'i mtshan nyid/ stobs rnams ni shin tu rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid / myi 'jigs ④pa rnams ni shin tu brtan pa'i mtshan nyid/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni myi chod pa'i mtshan nyid/ byams pa chen po ni phan pa sgrub ⑤pa'i mtshan nyid/ snying rje chen po ni yongs su skyob pa'i mtshan nyid/dga' ba chen po ni rab tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid/ btang ①snyoms chen po ni 'dre ba myed pa'i mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad ni myi 'phrogs ⑦pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes ni mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid de/ myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams kyi mtshan ⑧nyid gang yin pa dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid gang yin pa'i rang rang gi mtshan nyid de dag gis 0chos de dag thams cad stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag gi rang bzhin ⑩de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la 'das pa myi dmyigs pa dang /ma 'ongs pa myi dmyigs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i skyeganas myi dmyigs pa ste/myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa myi dmyigs pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni myi dmyigs pa 16—361

stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang zhe na / chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid myed de/ myi rtag myi 'jig pa'i phyir/ 'dus pa 'dus pas stong ngo ①//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang dngos po ni dngos pos stong ngo / /dngos po myed pa ni dngos po med pas stong ngo / /rang bzhin ni ②rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gzhan ②gyi dngos po ni gzhan gyi ④dngos pos stong ngo / /de la dngos po dngos po zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ phung po lnga po ste / phung po de dag kyang phung po ⑤rnams kyis dustong bas/ de ltar na dngos po dngos pos stong ngo / /ji ltar na dngos po myed pa dngos po myed pas stong zhe na / dngos po myed pa zhes bya ba ni 'dus ma byas te/ 'dus ma byas de yang 'dus ma byas kyis stong bas/ de ltar na dngos po myed pa dngos po myed pas stong ngo / /ji ltar na rang bzhin rang bzhin gyis stong zhe na/ rang bzhin zhes bya ba ni ngo bo nyid ma nor ba ste/ de la stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni shes pas ma byas/ mthong bas ma byas te/ 'di ⑦ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /de la gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ma byung yang rung ste/ chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos skyon myed pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ni de bzhin ⑧du gnas pa ste / de ltar chos de dag gi ⑨gzhan gyis 0stong pa gang yin pa de ni/ gzhan 16—362

gyi dngos po stong pa nyid ces bya ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gnyis ①pa/rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/ dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rin chen ②phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / seng ge rnam par rtse ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /zla ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad las shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / spyi gtsug rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi dbyings su nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /nges pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ting nge 'dzin la rgyal po ltar rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / borab tu bde bar gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po ②bde bar 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /mdu'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bo'akhrul ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pas 'khrul ba myed par byed pa ①zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / brtson pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /7 dpung rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nges pa'i 16—363

tshig la gdon myi za bar 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / tshig bla dgas la yang dag par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyogs rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyam ①pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad yang dag par 'du ba rgya mjo'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgyal po'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /rgya nam mkha' rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje'i rgyadakyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /④ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dbang po'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /rgyun kyi rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ༅seng ge rnam par rkyong ⑤ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / seng ge rnam par glal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /lo snrol zhi ⑦zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chags pa dang thogs pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /⑤ nyon mongs pa spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / tshol ⑨ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gnas la rten ⑩pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bdud bzhi 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /yi dri ma myed pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /16—364

kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dag pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /dga' ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / glog gi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zad myi shes pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / myi 'pham ①pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gzi brjid yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zad pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /myi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rab tu zhi ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /② 'jig pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyi ma'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zla ba dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / myig yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /②shes rab sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / snang ba gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zla ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /④snang ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bya ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rin chen mtha' zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos dam pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dga' ba spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyis 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyis 'phags pas yongs su rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /16—365

rin po che nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'khrug pa spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /① rnam par 'thor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad kyi tshig rab tu 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dri ma myed par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /② yi ge mnyam par 'god pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dmyigs pa gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'gyur ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mying dang mtshan ma la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / bya ba dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /② phying nges par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gnas myed par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rab rib myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / spyod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / g.yo ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yul las rgal ④ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yon tan thams cad kyi tshogs su gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sems myed par gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nges par gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /⑤dge ba'i me tog rgyas shing gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / byang chub kyi yan lag yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / spobs pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mtha' yas sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /yi myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad las 'da' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yongs 16—366

su gcod pa byed pa ①zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nem nur rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gnas su bya ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gcig tu ②rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /rnam pa mngon par sgrub ②pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam pa gcig tu gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam pa ④'dor ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / spyod pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /⑤rtogs pas srid pa'i gzhi thams cad khong du chud pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / brda yidang sgra la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / borin cen ④snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad la chags pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / glog gi 'od gzer khyabakod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 0spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyir myi ldog pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par sgrub lku pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /ma0 sgra dbyangs kyi yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgron ma 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mtshan nyid yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mngon par dmyigs pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ma 'dres pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /8 rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /tshu bde ba dang sdug bsngal thams cad la mngon par dga' ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zad myi shes pa'i za ma tog 8ces bya ba'i 16—367

ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi blo gros zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /yang dag pa dang log pa thams cad yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'gal ba dang 'gog pa thams cad yang dag par zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / mthun ①pa dang 'gal ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /snying po dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zla ba dri ma myed par rgyas pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / glog gi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgyan chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ②rnam pa thams cad du 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'jig rten thams cad skyob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /④ ting nge 'dzin mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdul myed cing rdul dang bral ba'i tshul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyon mongs pa myed par yang dag par gzhol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa thams cad ④nyon mongs pa myed par yang dag par gzhol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gnas dmyigs su myed pa la brtson pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin nyid la gnas shing sems myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / snod las rang 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad sreg pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ye shes chen po'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / stobs bcu'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sgo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /me lus kyi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 16—368

dang / ngag gi skyon rnam par 'jig pas nam mkha' ltar gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / ngag gi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yid kyi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / kun tu rtog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang /① nam mkha' ltar chags pa myed pas rnam par grol zhing gos pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /②de la dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de ni ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi spyod yul la spyod pa ste/ 'di ni dpa' ②bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rin chen phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin des ④ting nge 'dzin thams cad rgyas btab pa lta bur 'gyur ba ste/'di ni rin chen phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la seng ge rnam par rtse ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyis ⑤rnam par rtse ba ste/ 'di ni seng ge rnam par rtse ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad snang bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la zla ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de ni ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni zla ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos thams cad las shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyis mngon par 'phags 16—369

pa stekhya/ 'di ni chos thams cad las shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / ༅de la chos thams cad kyi ②phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi phyag rgya 'dzin 0pa ste/ 'di ni chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to / /za④de la spyi gtsug rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi spyi gtsug rnam par lta ba ste/ 'di ni spyi gtsug rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos kyi (chodabyings su nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos kyi dbyings su rtogs ⑥par 'gro ba ste/'di ni chos kyi dbyings su nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la nges pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan nges par 'dzin pa ste/'di ni nges pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /ting nge 'dzin thams cad 'jig par myi 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad kyi phyag rgya la 'jug pa ste/ 'di ni chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la ting nge 'dzin la rgyal po ltar rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /⑦ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rgyal po ltar rab tu gnas pa ste/ 'di ni ting nge 16—370

'dzin la rgyal po ltar rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / sgode la rab tu bde bar gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing bsod nams kyi tshogs kun 'dzin cing chud myi za bar byed pa ste/'di ni rab tu bde bar gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po ①bde bar 'dzugs ②pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po thams cad bde bar 'jog cing 'dzugs ②pa ste/ 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po bde bar 'dzugs ④pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / ⑤de la 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa ste/ 'di ni 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / sgode la 'khrul pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad kyi spyod yul dang / spyod pa thams cad rjes su dran zhing nyams pa myed par ⑥byed pa ste/ 'di ni 'khrul pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pas 'khrul pa myed par byed pa'i ④ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od gzer ②gyis sems can gyi khams snang bar byed cing / sngon gyi spyod pa rjes su dran par byed pa ste/ 'di ni 'od gzer ⑨rab tu 'gyed pas 'khrul pa myed par byed ⑩pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la brtson pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi brtson pa'i mthu skyed ⑩par byed pa ste/ 'di ni brtson pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /matso16—371

de la dpung rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi stobs rnam par dgod ①pa ste/ 'di ni dpung rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad yang dag par 'phags par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to / /de la nges pa'i tshig la gdon myi za bar 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi nges pa'i tshig bstan pa la 'jug pa ste/ 'di ni nges pa'i tshig la gdon myi za bar 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la tshig bla dgas la yang dag par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi tshig bla dgas la 'jug pa ste/'di ni tshig bla dgas la yang dag par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la phyogs rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi phyogs rnam par lta ba ste/'di ni phyogs rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa ste/'di ni phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la nyam ②pa myed pa ①zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad nyam 0par myi 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni nyam du16—372

pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos thams cad yang dag par 'du ba rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ①/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad 'du zhing khongs su ②chud par 'dong ba ste/ 'di ni chos thams cad yang dag par 'du ba rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la rgyal po'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / don thams cad nges par sgrub ②pa la ji ltar rgyal po'i phyag rgyas 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par byed pa lta bu ste/ 'di ni rgyal po'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /7de la nam mkha' rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyis ⑤nam mkha' rgyas par ⑥'gengs pa ste/ 'di ni nam mkha' rgyas par ⑦'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rdo rje'i nidakyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni rdo rje'i ⑨dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad ting nge ⑩'dzin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi 0spyod yul du myi 'dzin ⑫pa ste/ 'di ni 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /matso bode la rgyal mtshan 8rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ji ltar rgyal mtshan dam pa bzhin 8ting nge 'dzin thams cad las khyad par du ⑩'phags pa ste/ 'di ni rgyal mtshan 7rtse 16—373

mo'i dpung rgyan ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la dbang po'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi dbang dam pa nges par ①thob pa ste/ 'di ni dbang po'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rgyun gyi rjes su song ba zhes ②bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rjes su phyin ci ②ma log par yang dag par zhugs pa ste/'di ni rgyun gyi rjes su song ba zhes ④bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes ⑤bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / rdul dang dri ma ⑥thams cad rab tu spangs pa'i ⑦dbang du gyur cing / ji ltar seng ge'i durgyal po bzhin du khyadabang dam pa ⑨ thob pas bsgyings pa lta bu ste/ 'di ni seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /tshe nyuskre bode la seng ge rnam par rkyong 8ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing cho 'phrul dam pa'i dbang thob pas 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba myed cing / bdud thams cad kyi dpung 'jig cing 'dzul nyunyebar byed pa ste/ 'di ni seng ge rnam par rkyong ④ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la seng ge rnam par glal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing spobs pa dam pa dang ldan pas 'khor mang po'i nang du bag tsha ba myed par/ mu stegs can log par lta ba thams cad 'dul ba ste / 'di ni seng ge rnam par glal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mthoge zode la snrel zhi hu9zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / 'khor ba'i chos ⑩rnams rgyun nges par tsogacod par byed pa ste/16—374

'di ①ni snrel zhi ②zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / de la chags pa dang thogs pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing chos thams cad la 'dzin pa dang thogs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ni chags pa dang thogs pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /①༄de la nyon mongs pa spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi dri ma rab tu sel ba ste/ 'di ni nyon mongs pa spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad lham me lhan ne lhang nger byed pa ste/ 'di ni rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la tshol ⑤ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos gang yang tshol skyob myed pa ste/ 'di ni tshol ⑦ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la gnas la rten dupa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /chos gang yang gnas la rten ⑨par yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni gnas la rten ⑩pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la sems myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /sems kyang myi 'byung sems las byung 0ba rnams kyang myi rgyu ba ste/ 'di ni sems myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / de la bdud bzhi 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing bdud bzhi'i dgra thams cad 'dul bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni bdud bzhi 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /8de la dri ma myed pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 16—375

'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi sgron ma dri ma myed par byed pa ste/ 'di ni dri ma myed pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la 'od mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / 'od mtha' yas par byed pa ste/'di ni 'od mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ⑨ting nge 'dzin 'di thob ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi 'od byed pa ste/ 'di ni 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de thob ②ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi sgo snang bar byed pa ste / 'di ni kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la dag pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi dag pa mnyam pa nyid 'thob ①pa ste/ 'di ni dag pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la 'od dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi dri ma sel ba ste/ 'di ni 'od dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la dga' ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi dga' ba nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni dga' ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to//de la glog gi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi sgron ma byed pa ste/ 'di ni glog gi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la zad myi shes pa zhes bya ba'i ting 16—376

nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad zad shes pa dang / zad myi shes pa yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ①ste/'di ni zad myi shes pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la myi 'pham pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi stobs rab tu thob ②pa ste/ 'di ni myi 'pham pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /7de la gzi brjid yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi gzi brjid dang / dpal gyis ④'bar bar 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni gzi brjid yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la zad pa dang bral ⑤ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ⑥/ting nge 'dzin thams cad zad myi shes par rjes su mthong nas/ rdul tsam yang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba de ltar mthong ba ste/ 'di ni zad pa dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la myi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad myi g.yo myi 'gul rab tu myi 'byed/ zlas sems su myi byed pa ste/ 'di ni myi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / de la rab tu zhi ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing mnyam par gzhag pa rnams rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni rab tu zhi ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /⑦de la 'jig pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad 'jig par yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni 'jig pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 16—377

'dzin to/ /de la nyi ma'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi sgo snang bar byed pa ste/'di ni nyi ma'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la zla ba dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /ting nge 'dzin thams cad mun pa myed par byed pa ste/ 'di ni zla ba dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /① bode la shes rab sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sel bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni shes rab sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / de la myig yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / myig lnga yongs su dag par byed pa ste/ 'di ni myig yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /② ①de la snang ba gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rab tu 'thob ④pa ste/ 'di ni snang ba gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la zla ba'i ༅sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na / ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing sems can rnams kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba dang / zla ba bzhin du gyur pa ste/ 'di ni zla ba'i ༅sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / ⑦de la snang ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi sgo snang bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni snang ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la bya ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la 16—378

gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi bya ba rnams byed pa ste/ 'di ni bya ba byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la ye shes dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi ye shes dpal yang dag par rjes su mthong ba ste/ 'di ni ye shes dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin nyid kyang yang dag par rjes su myi mthong bar khong du chud par byed pa ste/ 'di ni rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la sems gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas na①/ sems myi g.yo rnam par myi g.yo rnam par myi ldog /yongs su yi 'chad ②par myi 'gyur/ nyams su myi bde ba myed la/ de la sems zhes bya ba ni 'di yin zhes bya bar sems myi 'byung ba ste/ 'di ni sems gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / thams cad snang bar yang dag par rjes su lamathong ba ste/ 'di ni kun tu byasnang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la ⑤rab tu gnas par 'gyur ba ste/'di ni rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rin chen mtha' zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /ting nge 'dzin thams cad rin chen dumatha' ltar kun nas snang ba ste/ 'di ni rin chen mtha' zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos dam pa'i phyag rgya 16—379

zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /ting nge 'dzin thams cad phyag rgya myed pa'i mthas/ phyag rgyas ①btab pa nye bar bzung bas phyag rgyas btab par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni chos dam pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos gang yang mnyam pa nyid du ma chud pa myed par yang dag par rjes su mthong ba ste/'di ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la dga' ba spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang chos thams cad kyi dga' ba spong ba ste/ 'di ni dga' ba spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos kyis ②'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad kyi mun pa sel ba dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyis mngon par 'phags par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni chos kyis ①'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la chos kyis 'phags pas yongs su rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'phags shing yongs su rdzogs ④pa ste/ 'di ni chos kyis 'phags pas yongs su rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rin po che nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing yon tan rin po ce chen po ⑤mtha' yas pa thams cad kyi 'byung khung du dugyur pa ste/'di ni rin po ce ④nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la 'khrug pa spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing 'jig 16—380

rten gyi rtsod pa dang 'khrug pa rnam pa sna tshogs spong ba ste/ 'di ni 'khrug pa spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /mnyade la rnam par 'thor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad rnam par 'thor ba ste/ 'di ni ②rnam par 'thor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos thams cad kyi tshig rab tu 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang chos thams cad kyi tshig rab tu 'byed pa ste/ 'di ni chos thams cad kyi tshig rab tu 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / ༅de la rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /chos rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid nges par 'thob pa ste/ 'di ni rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la dri ma myed par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing spyod pa mtha' yas pa rnam par dag pa ③skyed pa ste/ 'di ni dri ma myed par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /4de la yi ge mnyam par 'god pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi yi ge mnyam pa nyid rab tu 'thob pa ste/ 'di ni yi ge mnyam par 'god pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi yi ge gcig kyang dmyigs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ni yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la dmyigs pa gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi du dmyigs pa 16—381

'chad ①par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni dmyigs pa gcod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la 'gyur ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad 'gyur ba myi dmyigs pa ste/'di ni 'gyur ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rnam pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /chos thams cad kyi rnam pa tsam yang ②dmyigs pa myed pa ①ste/ 'di ni rnam pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / chade la mying dang mtshan ma la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /chos thams cad kyi mying dang mtshan ma la 'jug pa yang dag pa'i mtha' rtogs par byed pa ste/ 'di ni mying dang mtshan ma la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la bya ba dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / bya ba thams cad kun spong pa ste/ 'di ni bya ba dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /④de la nges pa'i mying la ⑤'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /nges pa'i tshig thams cad ni yang dag par dmyigs su myed cing tha snyad la ltos ⑥pa tsam mo zhes rtog pa ⑦'jug pa ste/ 'di ni nges pa'i mying la du'ajug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sngalade la gnas myed par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi gnas dmyigs pa myed pa ste/ 'di ni gnas myed par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rab rib myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad kyi rab rib rnam 16—382

par sel ba ste/ 'di ni rab rib myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la spyod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi spyod pa yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni spyod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la g.yo ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad g.yo ba myed par yang dag par rjes su mthong ba ste/ 'di ni g.yo ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la yul las rgal ①ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi yul las yang dag par 'da' ba ste/'di ni yul las rgal ②ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la yon tan thams cad kyi tshogs su gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad dang duting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi yon tan gyi tshogs rjes su 'thob pa ste/ 'di ni yon tan thams cad kyi tshogs su gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la sems myed par gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la ④sems myi 'jug pa ste/ 'di ni sems myed par gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / de la nges par gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ting nge 'dzin de dag la sems nges par gnas kyang / de'i mtshan nyid dmyigs su myed par rtogs pa ste/'di ni nges par gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /⑤de la dge ba'i mye tog rgyas shing gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de 16—383

la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi dge ba'i me tog rgyas shing gsal ba rab tu 'thob pa ste/ 'di ni dge ba'i me tog rgyas shing gsal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la byang chub kyi yan lag yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi byang chub kyi yan lag bdun rab tu 'thob pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub kyi yan lag ①yod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la spobs ②pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /ting nge 'dzin thams cad la spobs pa mtha' yas pa rab tu 'thob pa ste/ 'di ni spobs pa mtha' yas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / ngade la mtha' yas sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ji ltar sgron ma gsal bas chos thams cad rab tu snang bar byed pa ④lta bu ste/'di ni mtha' yas sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / ④de la myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa rab tu 'thob pa ste/ 'di ni myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos thams cad las 'da' ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / khams gsum pa thams cad las yang dag par 'da' ba ste/ 'di ni chos thams cad las ⑤ 'da' ba 0zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la yongs su gcod pa byed pa ⑦zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad dang ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyud nimathong ba ste/ 'di ni yongs su gcod pa byed pa zhes bya 16—384

ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la nem nur rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / chos thams cad la ༅nem nur rnam par sel ba rab tu 'thob ②pa ste / 'di ni nem nur rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la gnas su bya ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad kyi gnas yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste / 'di ni gnas su bya ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la gcig tu rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos gang yang gnyis su yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni gcig tu rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to//de la rnam pa mngon par sgrub ②pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rnam pa mngon par sgrub ④pa yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni rnam pa mngon par sgrub ⑤pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rnam pa gcig tu gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rnam pa yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni rnam pa gcig tu gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la rnam par du'ador ba myed pa ⑦zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad gnyis su myed par yang dag par rjes su ⑧mthong ba ste/ 'di ni rnam pa ⑨'dor ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la spyod pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/16—385

ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing snyoms ①par 'jug pa de dag ②las spyod pa rnam pa ①sna tshogs ston kyang gang la yang 'dzin pa myed pa ste/ 'di ni spyod pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /za④de la rtogs pas srid pa'i gzhi thams cad khong du chud pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad rtogs par byed pa'i ye shes la zhugs nas / de la zhugs pa'i phyir khong du myi duchud pa gang yang myed pa ste/ 'di ni rtogs pas srid pa'i gzhi thams cad khong du chud pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin tol/ /de la brda khyadang sgra la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi brda ⑦dang sgra la 'jug pa ste/ 'di ni brda dudang sgra la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /⑨ zode la rin chen snying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing 'gyur ba dang 'jigs pa myed cing yon tan dpag tu myed pa dang ldan pa'i rin po ce rgyu ⑨ dam pa sgrub pa ste/ 'di ni rin cen skyesnying po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos thams cad la chags pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing chos thams cad ni mtshan ma dang bral ba'i phyir chos gang la yang chags pa myed pa ste/ 'di ni chos thams cad la chags pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la glog gi 'od gzer tsobakod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / 'od gzer 0rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyed pas mun pa mun gnag ④sel ba dang / gzhan yang yon tan mtha' yas pa brgya 'god pa ste / 'di ni glog gi 'od gzer 8bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /16—386

de la nyuspong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / nyon mongs pa'i bag chags mtha' yas pa spong ba ste/ 'di ni ②spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la chos kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing chos rnams kyi rang rang ②spyi'i mtshan nyid snang bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni chos kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la ye shes sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos rnams kyi chos dang / gang zag la bdag myed pa ④gsal bar ston pa ste/ 'di ni ye shes sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la phyir myi ldog pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par sgrub ⑤pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul phyir myi ldog pa yigazhan gyis myi thub pa dam pa sgrub ⑦pa ste/'di ni phyir myi ldog pa'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par sgrub ④pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin tol/ /77de ⑩la sgra dbyangs kyi yi ge dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad yi ge dang bral bar 7rjes su mthong ba ste/ 'di ni sgra dbyangs kyi yi ge dang bral ba 8zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la sgron ma 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad gzi brjid kyis lham me lhan ne lhang nger byed pa ste/ 'di ni sgron ma 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la mtshan nyid yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi mtshan nyid yongs su dag par 'gyur ba ste0/ 'di ni 16—387

mtshan nyid yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la mngon par dmyigs pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad mngon par dmyigs pa myed par ①yang dag par rjes su mthong ba ste/ 'di ni mngon par dmyigs pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la ma 'dres pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa② zhes bya ba'i ②ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad la ma 'dres pa'i bzod pa 'thob pa ste/ 'di ni ma 'dres pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /4de la rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa⑤ zhes bya ba'i yiting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ting nge 'dzin thams cad rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / ༅de la gzungs dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin ⑦gyi phyag rgya kun ⑧'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni gzungs dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ma0de la bde ba dang sdug bsngal thams cad la mngon par dga' ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la bde ba dang sdug bsngal yang dag par rjes su myi ⑩mthong ba ste / 'di ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal thams cad la mngon par dga' ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la zad myi shes pa'i za ma tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad zad par rung bar yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni 16—388

zad myi shes pa'i za ma tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la gzungs kyi blo gros zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /gzungs ①thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni gzungs kyi blo gros zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la yang dag pa dang log pa thams cad yang dag par ②sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad yang dag pa dang / log par yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa dang / log pa thams cad yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la 'gal ba dang 'gog pa thams cad yang dag par zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la 'gal ba dang 'gog pa yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni 'gal ba dang 'gog pa thams cad yang dag par zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la mthun pa dang 'gal ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la mthun pa dang 'gal ba yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni mthun pa dang 'gal ba myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to②/ /de la 'od dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor myi dmyigs pa ste 'di ④ni 'od dri ma myed pa zhes bya ba'i ༷ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la snying po dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi snying po yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni snying po dang ldan pa zhes 16—389

bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /①de la zla ba dri ma myed par rgyas pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad 'di lta ste/ dper na/ zla ba nya ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni zla ba dri ma myed par rgyas pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la glog gi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / dag cing gsal ba'i 'od kyis ②sems can gyi ris snang bar byas shing mun pa mun nag dang tsha ba'i gdung ba sel bar ①byed pa ste/ 'di ni glog gi ④'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /maXde la rgyan chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad rgyan chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ba ste/'di ni rgyan chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /⑥de la rnam pa thams cad du 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad snang bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni rnam pa ⑦thams cad du 'od byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / de la 'jig rten thams cad skyob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal thams cad skyob pa ste/ 'di ni 'jig rten thams cad skyob pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /nide la ting nge 'dzin mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad la 'khrug pa yang myi dmyigs rtse gcig kyang myi dmyigs pa ste/ 'di ni ting nge 'dzin mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / zo de la ①rdul ⑩skyed cing rdul dang bral ba'i tshul dang ldan pa zhes 16—390

bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang chos thams cad rdul can dang rdul dang bral bar mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa ste/ 'di ni rdul myed ①cing rdul dang bral ba'i tshul dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /chalade la nyon mongs pa myed par yang dag par gzhol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad ②nyon mongs pa myed par 'gyur ba ste/'di ni nyon mongs pa myed par yang dag par gzhol ba zhes bya ba'i ༷ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa thams cad nyon mongs pa myed par yang dag par gzhol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe ⑤na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa thams cad nyon mongs pa myed par yang dag par gzhol ba 'thob par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa thams cad nyon mongs pa myed par yang dag par gzhol ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la gnas dmyigs su myed pa la brtson pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi kun gzhi nye bar myi dmyigs pa ste/ 'di ni gnas dmyigs su myed pa la brtson pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la de bzhin nyid la gnas shing / sems myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid las phyir myi ldog pa ste/ 'di ni de bzhin nyid la gnas shing / sems myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / bode la snod las rang 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / mnyam par 16—391

gzhag pa'i mthus yon tan mang po skyed de ji ltar lha dag bsod nams kyi mthus kha zas ①dag snod las rang 'byung bar 'gyur ba lta bu ste/ 'di ni snod las rang 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la nyon mongs pa thams cad sreg pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi tha ba ma lus par sreg pa ste/ 'di ni nyon mongs pa thams cad sreg pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la ye shes chen po'i ②sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ye shes kyi 'od kyis thams cad snang bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni ye shes chen po'i ②sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la stobs bcu'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobaso bcu myur du yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ste/ 'di ni stobs bcu'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la sgo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / sems can rnams kyi don du dam po'i chos kyi sgo phye bas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chen po las myur du sgrol ba ste/ 'di ni sgo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /7de la lus kyi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi lus myi dmyigs pa ste/ 'di ni lus kyi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la ngag gi skyon rnam par 'jig dupas nam mkha' ltar gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi 16—392

ngag gi las myi dmyigs pa ste 'di ni ngag gi skyon rnam par 'jig pas nam mkha' ltar gyur pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / de la ngag gi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi ngag gi las myi dmyigs pa ste/ 'di ni ngag gi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /① ༅de la yid kyi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi yid kyi las myi dmyigs pa ste/'di ni yid kyi skyon yang dag par sel ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la kun tu rtog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / sems can rnams kyi ②dbang po'i bye brag la kun tu rtog cing grol bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni kun tu rtog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la nam mkha' lta bu'i ②ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing ji ltar nam mkha' bzhin ④sems can rnams la snyoms par phan 'dogs pa ste / 'di ni nam mkha' lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /lode la nam mkha' ltar chags pa myed pas rnam par grol zhing gos pa myed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar chags pa myed pas rnam par grol zhing gos pa myed pa 'thob pa ste/'di ni nam mkha' ltar chags pa myed pas rnam par grol zhing gos pa skyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin te'u/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i theg pa chen po'o⑦/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las le'u brgyad dol// //16—393

pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /de la ①lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal ②cing / rnam par spyod kyang lus dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams rgyal rnam par myi rtog go/ /phyi'i lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ༅ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing / rnam par spyod kyang lus dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams la rnam par myi rtog go/ /phyi nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing / rnam par spyod kyang lus dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams ⑤la rnam par myi rtog go/ /nang gi tshor ba la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi duchags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing / rnam par spyod kyang tshor ba 16—394

dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams ①la rnam par myi rtog go/ /phyi'i tshor ba ②la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang / yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod kyang / tshor ba dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams dul rnam par myi rtog go/ /phyi nang gi tshor ba la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis metshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod kyang /tshor ba dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams la rnam par myi rtog go/ /nang gi sems la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sems kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing / rnam par spyod kyang sems dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams ⑤la rnam par myi rtog go/ /phyi'i sems la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis ⑥sems kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa ⑦dran pa dang ldan pas 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod kyang sems dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams la rnam par myi rtog go/ /phyi nang gi sems la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis dusems kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing / rnam par spyod kyang sems dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams la ⑨rnam par myi rtog go/ /nang gi chos la de myi 16—395

dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod kyang ①/ chos dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams la rnam par myi rtog go/ /phyi'i chos la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing / rnam ther spyod kyang chos dang ldan pa'i ②rnam par rtog pa rnams la rnam par myi rtog go/ /phyi nang gi chos la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis chos kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas②/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod kyang / chos dang ldan pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams la rnam par myi rtog go/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ nang gi lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / rnam par spyod pa yin zhe na/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'gro na 'gro'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /'greng na 'greng ngo zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /'dug na 'dug go zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /nyal na nyal lo zhes bya bar rab tu shes te④/ de'i lus nyams bde ba'am ⑤nyams myi bde yang rung ste/ji lta ji ltar gnas pa/ de lta de ltar des ⑥rab tu shes te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam 16—396

par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing rnam par spyod de/ de ①'gro'am 'ong yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin / lta'am rnam par lta yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ bskum mam brkyang ②yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ sbyar ma dang lhung bzed 'chang zhing spyod kyang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ zos pa dang 'chos pa dang 'thungs pa ②dang / myangs pa la yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ nyal ba dang gnyid kyis ④mya myo bstsal ba la yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ 'gro ba dang 'ong ba la yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ 'greng ba dang 'dug pa la yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ gnyid kyis ②log gam ma log na yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/smra ba dang myi smra yin yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin/ nang du yang dag par 'jog pa la yang shes bzhin du spyod pa yin te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/nang gi lus la de ⑦phyi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dran zhing dbugs nang du rgyu na ⑧yang /dran zhing dbugs nang du rgyu'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dran zhing dbugs phyir rgyu na ⑨yang / dran zhing dbugs phyir rgyu'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dbugs nang du ring du rgyu na ⑩yang dbugs nang du ring du rgyu'o zhes bya bar rab 16—397

tu shes so/ /dbugs phyir ring du rgyu na ①yang / dbugs phyir ring du rgyu'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dbugs nang du thung ngu rgyu na ②yang / dbugs nang du thung ngu rgyu'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dbugs phyir thung ngu rgyu na ③yang / phyir dbugs ⑤thung ngu rgyu'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes te/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo skor ⑤ba'am/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo skor khyaba'i mchan bu mkhas pa ni/ ring du skor ⑦na ring du skor niro zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /thung ngu skor ⑨na thung ngu skor 0ro zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dran par dbugs nang du rgyus skyon yang / dran par dbugs nang du rgyus 8so zhes bya bar rab tu shes so//dran par dbugs phyir rgyus tson yang dran par dbugs phyir rgyus ④so zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dbugs ring du nang du rgyus tson yang / dbugs ring du nang du rgyus 0so zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dbugs ring du phyir rgyus tshun yang / dbugs ring du phyir rgyus 8so zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dbugs thung ngu nang du rgyus yin yang / dbugs thung ngu nang du rgyus ⑥so zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dbugs thung ngu phyir rgyus 0na yang / dbugs thung ngu phyir rgyus 3so zhes bya bar rab tu shes te/ rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/nang gi lus la de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /16—398

rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ lus 'di la sa'i khams kyang yod do/ /chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams kyang yod do zhes bya bar khams kyi rnam par yang dag pa ①ci ②lta ba bzhin du rab tu rtog ste/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ ba lang gi shen pa'am/ ba lang gi shin pa'i mchan bu mkhas pas mtshon rnon po thogs te/ ba lang bsad cing bag bzhir gshags ①te/ de ltar so sor phye nas/ 'greng ngam 'dug ste/ de la rab tu rtog pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yang / lus 'di la sa'i khams kyang yod do//chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams kyang yod do zhes bya bar khams kyi rnam pa ④yang dag pa ji lta ⑤ba bzhin du ④rtog ste'u/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / 'greng ngam 'dug ste/ nang gi lus la de lamyi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi rjes su lta zhing / brtson 'grus can shes bzhin dang ldan pa dran pa dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi chags sems dang / yid myi bde ba rnam par bstsal cing rnam par spyod do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe / lus 'di nyid la rkang pa'i mthil yan chad⑨/ skra dang glad ⑩pa man chad skyedu/ sen mo dang / spu dang pags 8pa yan chad tsodu myi gtsang ba sna tshogs kyis gang bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du8 rtog ste④/ lus 'di la skra dang / spu dang sen mo dang / pags tshupa dang / glog pa ⑩dang / sha 16—399
