yongs su spang ba gang zhe na/ phyi nang gi chos rnams yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bdag stod ①pa yongs su spang ba'o/ /de la ji ltar na ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gzhan smod pa yongs su spang ba gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phyi rol kyi chos rnams yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gzhan smod pa yongs su spang ba'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos myi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yongs su spang bar bya ba yin zhe na/ de dag ni 'di ltar bde 'gro la yang bar du gcod na/ 'phags pa'i lam lta la ci smos te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lta la smos kyang myi dgos kyis ②spang bar bya'o zhes spong ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i myi dge ba rjobacu'i las kyi lam yongs su spang bar bya ba'o⑤/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos lhag pa'i nga rgyal yongs su spang bar bya ba yin zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des chos gang yang yang dag par rjes su mthong ba myed na gang gis nga rgyal du 'gyur ba'i lhag pa lta ci smos zhes nga rgyal du myi byed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lhag pa'i nga rgyal yongs su spang bar bya'odu/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khengs pa yongs su spang bar bya ba yin zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des gang la khengs pa skye bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i dngos po yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i khengs pa yongs su spang bar bya ba'o⑦/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 16—450

sems dpa' chen pos phyin ci log rnams yongs su spang bar bya ba yin zhe na/dngos por myi dmyigs pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i phyin ci log rnams yongs su spang bar bya ba'o①/ / bode la ci ②ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos yid gnyis spang dubar bya zhe na/ gang gi phyir chos thams cad yid gnyis dang bral bar mthong ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yid gnyis yongs su spang bar bya ba'o/ /mdude la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug nyam ⑤rangs su myi 'dor ba yin zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug nyam rangs su myi 'dor ba'o/ /de la sa drug pa la chos drug yongs su rdzogs par bya ba gang zhe na/ 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba 0ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po 'di dag la gnas te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams ༅shes par bya ba'i gang chen mtsho lnga'i pha rol tu phyin par gyur to/ /phyin to/ /phyin par 'gyur ro/ /lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba dang / myi brjod pa dang / 'dus ma byas tel/ de 16—451

ltar ①byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos drug yongs su spang bar bya ba yin zhe na/② 'di ltar de ni byang chub kyi lam ma yin pas/ nyan thos kyi sems yongs su spang bar bya'oX//'di ltar de ni byang chub kyi lam ma yin pas/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sems yongs su spang bar bya'o⑤/ /'di ltar de ni byang chub kyi lam ma yin pas/ sred pa'i sems yongs su spang bar bya'odu/ /'di ltar de ni byang chub kyi lam ma yin pas/slongs ⑦mo pa mthong na sems zhum pa myi bskyed do/ /'di ltar de ni byang chub kyi lam ma yin pas/ dngos po thams cad yongs su gtang ⑤bas yid myi bde bar myi bya'o/ /'di ltar de ni byang chub kyi lam ma yin pas/ thog ma sems bskyed nas/ kha za yag 0gi sems su myi bya'i sbyin pa yongs su gtang ⑩bar bya'o zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos drug yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /tunyede la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdag tu 'dzin par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bdag shin tu myed pa'i phyir ro/ /sems can du 'dzin par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sems can shin tu myed pa'i phyir ro/ /srog tu 'dzin par myi bya zhe na/de ni 'di ltar srog shin tu myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zag tu 'dzin par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang zag shin tu myed pa'i phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chad par 'dzin par myi bya zhe na/de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad shin tu ma skyes pa'i phyir chos gang yang chad 8pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 16—452

pos rtag par 'dzin par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos gang la skye ba myed pa de la rtag pa dang / chad pa myed pa'i phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mtshan ma'i 'du shes su ①kyi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar kun nas nyon mongs pa shin tu myed pa'i phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rgyur lta bar myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des lta ba de yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mying dang gzugs la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des/ de'i dngos po yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos phung po la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar phung po shin tu myed pa'i phyir te/ de ltar na ②phung po la mngon par chags par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/khams la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar khams rnams shin tu myed pa'i phyir te/ de ltar na khams la mngon par chags par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ skye mched la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar skye mched rnams shin tu myed pa'i phyir te/ de ltar na ③skye mched la mngon par chags par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khams gsum la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de'i rang bzhin myed pa'i phyir te/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ khams gsum la mngon par chags par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar dun byang chub sems dpa' 16—453

sems dpa' chen pos khams gsum la mngon par zhen par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de'i dngos po myed cing myi dmyigs pa'i phyir te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khams gsum la mngon par zhen par myi bya'o//de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khams gsum la brten par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de'i dngos po myed pa'i phyir te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khams gsum la brten par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khams gsum la gnas par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de'i dngos po myed pa'i phyir te/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ khams gsum la gnas par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ sangs rgyas la brten ①pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas su lta ba la brten ②pas/ sangs rgyas mthong bar myi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de ltar na ③byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/sangs rgyas la brten ①pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na ⑤byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos la brten ༷pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos su lta ba la brten ⑦pas/ chos mthong bar myi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de ltar na ⑧byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ chos la brten ⑨pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/dge 'dun la brten pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dge 'dun du lta ba la brten (nyepas/ dge 'dun mthong bar myi 16wa 454

'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de ltar na ①byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/dge 'dun la brten ②pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ tshul khrims la brten ②pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags par myi bya zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims su lta ba la brten ༷pas/ tshul khrims rnam par dag par myi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ tshul khrims la brten ⑤pa'i lta ba la mngon par chags par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ chos rnams stong ngo zhes zhum par myi bya zhe na/de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong pa ma yin gyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyis 0stong pa'i phyir te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ stong pa nyid la zhum par myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ stong pa nyid dang 'gal bar myi bya zhe na/de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa ⑦bas/ stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid dang 'gal bar myi byed pa'i phyir te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ stong pa nyid dang 'gal bar myi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya ba yin ⑧zhe na/ rang gi ⑨mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs pa ni/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos mtshan ma myed pa mngon du bya ba yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mtshan ma thams cad yid la myi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 16—455

smon pa myed pa shes pa yin zhe na/ de ni khams gsum ①thams cad du sems myi 'jug pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can thams cad la snying rje zhing snying brtse ba yongs su rdzogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ sems can thams cad la brnyas par myi bya zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byams pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid du lta ba gang yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad la bsnan ②pa dang dbri ba myed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yang dag pa'i tshul rab tu rtogs pa gang yin zhe na/ chos thams cad tshul gcig tu rtogs kyang rtogs pa myed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i myi skye ba ③la bzod pa gang yin zhe na/ chos thams cad skye ba myed pa dang / 'gag pa myed pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa la bzod pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i myi skye ba shes pa gang yin zhe na/ mying dang gzugs myi skye ba shes pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i myi skye ba shes pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos thams cad tshul gcig tu bstan pa gang yin rjozhe na/ gnyis la yongs su rgyu ba myed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos thams cad tshul gcig tu bstan pa'o/ /de la byang 16—456

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rtog pa yang dag par bstsal ba gang yin zhe na/ chos thams cad la rnam par rtog pa myed pa'o①/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lta ba rnam par bzlog pa gang yin zhe na/nyan thos kyi sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa rnam par spong ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i nyon mongs pa rnam par bzlog pa gang yin zhe na/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad zad pa'o//de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis gang yin ②zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dul ba'i sems gang yin zhe na/ khams gsum la dga' bar ①sems pa 0skyed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i zhi ba'i sems gang zhe na/ dbang po drug yang dag par 'dus pa'o/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thogs pa skyed pa'i ye shes gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan thob pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byams pa'i skabs shes pa gang zhe na/ skye mched drug gi btang snyoms so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gang du 'dod pa'i zhing du 'gro ba gang zhe na/ gang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang ma g.yos bzhin du/sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyang yang dag par mthong la/ 'di la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'du shes kyang myi 'byung ba gang yin pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thams cad du bdag gi ngo bo ston pa gang zhe na⑤/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su gang dang gang la dga' ba de la ci 16—457

ltar dga' ba rang gi ngo bo de dang de ②ston pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can thams cad kyi sems khong du chud pa gang zhe na/ sems gcig gis sems can thams cad kyi sems dang sems las byung ba rab tu shes pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mngon par shes pas rnam par rtse ②ba gang zhe na/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyis rnam par rtse ③zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi 0zhing du sangs rgyas blta ba'i don du 'gro yang / de la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes su myi 'gyur ba'o//de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing blta ba gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig na 'dug cing dpag tu myed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mthong yang / de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'du shes su myi 'gyur ba'o//de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag ji ltar mthong ba bzhin du yongs su bsgrub pa gang zhe na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur ⑤ba'i sa la gnas te/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 0yongs su gtong zhing /des rlom sems su myi byed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas ⑦bsnyen bkur ba gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i don du chos la bsnyen bkur ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi sku yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du brtag ⑧pa gang zhe na/ chos kyi sku yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs ⑨par byed pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dbang po rab dang / tha ma shes pa gang zhe na/ stobs bcu la gnas shing / sems can 16—458

thams cad kyi dbang po ①yongs su rdzogs par shes pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong ②ba gang zhe na/ myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis sems can thams cad kyi sems yongs su sbyong ③ba'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin gang la gnas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 0bya ba thams cad byed kyang ⑤/ de'i sems chos gang la yang myi 'jug pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yang dang yang mnyam par gzhag pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rnam par sbyin pa las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ji lta ji ltar 'grub pa rjode lta de ltar lus yongs su sgrub ⑦pa gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can rnams ji lta ji ltar yongs su sbyin par du'agyur ba de lta de ltar ched du bsams shing ⑨lus yongs su 'dzin to/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ched du bsams shing ⑩/ srid pa nye bar len pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i phyir ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ji lta ji ltar smon pa de lta de ltar phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ ji lta ji ltar smon pa de lta de ltar phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin 16—459

dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i skad shes par bya ba khong du chud pa ①yin zhe na/'di lta ste/ nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pas khong du chud pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos yongs su rdzogs pa'i spobs pas nges par bstan pa shes par bya ba rtogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pas khong du chud pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ma'i mngal du 'gro ba phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po②/ tshe rabs thams cad du rdzus ②shing skye ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ma'i mngal du 'gro ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rigs phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i durigs chen por skye ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rigs phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rgyud phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'am/ bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho bar skye ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rgyud phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rus phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi ⑤rigs su sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams byung rjobar gyur pa de'i rigs su skye ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i rus phun sum ④tshogs pa'o/ /de la 16—460

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos byang chub tu sems can rnams bkod cing / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang ldan pa nyid du 'gyur ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshe phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skyes ①ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams snang bas rgyas par bkang ste/ de dag rnam pa drug tu g.yo bar byed pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshe phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mngon par 'byung ba phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rab tu 'byung ba'i phyir/ sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang /lhan cig ②tu mngon par 'byung zhing sems can de dag kyang theg pa gsum la ③nges par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mngon par 'byung ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub kyi shing gi rgyan phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub kyi shing gi rtsa ba gser gyi rgyu las byung ba yin/ lhun be+e ḍūd+mar du'adug pa yin/ yal ga rin po ce ⑤bdun gyi rang bzhin las grub pa yin/ me tog dang / lo ma rin po ce duthams cad las gyur pa yin/ shing de'i dri zhim po dang / 'od bzang pos 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa rgyas par gang ⑦ba yin te/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i byang chub kyi shing gi rgyan phun sum 16—461

tshogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ①sa bcu ②la gnas pa de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ces bya ba gang zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ①gang gis pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa dag ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa bcu dul gnas pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ces bya'o//rab 'byor de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sa bcu gang zhe na/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs mkhas pas ⑤sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / shes rab ༷kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / nang stong pa nyid 16—462

la spyod pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa ①dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la spyod pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams la spyod pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la spyod pa dang / dbang po rnams la spyod pa dang / stobs rnams la ②spyod pa dang /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la spyod pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyod pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la spyod pa dang /bsam gtan rnams la spyod pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa dang /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la spyod pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad la spyod pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la spyod pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la spyod pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams la spyod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams la spyod pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams la spyod 16—463

pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la spyod pa dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi la spyod pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la spyod pa dang / snying rje chen po la spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad la spyod pa'i tshe/ dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa las yang dag par 'da'/rigs kyi sa las yang dag par 'da'/ brgyad pa'i sa las yang dag par 'da'/mthong ba'i sa las yang dag par 'da'/ bslabs ①pa'i sa las yang dag par 'da' / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa las yang dag par 'da'/ byas pa rtogs ②pa'i sa las yang dag par 'da'/ nyan thos kyi sa las yang dag par 'da' / ② rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las yang dag par 'da'/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa las yang dag par 'da' ste/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de ltar sa dgu las yongs su 'das nas/sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas pa ④ste④/ rab 'byor 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sa bcu'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyatheg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs par rig par bya'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bco lnga ⑦pa/rab 'byor khyod kyis gang yang 'di skad du theg pa de gang nas 'byung bar 'gyur zhes smras pa ni/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis khams gsum nas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar theg pa chen po gang yin pa dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang yin pa'i chos de gnyis ka yang ldan pa yang 16—464

nyid stong pa nyid 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor nang stong pa ①nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /②phyi stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa 16—477

stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /dor ba skyed pa stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa skyed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid nang stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid don dam 16—478

pa stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rang gi ①mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro//ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ②kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do//rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid skyed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/yang dag par spong ba rnams/ 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi ①rkang pa rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid skyed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ dbang po rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 16—479

'dod pa de ni/ stobs rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa med do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni dran pa nye bar gzhag ①pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi 0rkang pa rnams kyi 16wa 480

ngo bo nyid ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi ①ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang po rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni dbang po rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /stobs rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ stobs rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ngo bo nyid ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ bsam gtan rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ tshad myed pa rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ rnam par thar pa rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ stong pa nyid 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ mtshan ma myed pa 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i 16—481

chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ smon pa myed pa 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam ①pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ②ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam ②pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /mtshan ma myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /smon pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi 0ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni bsam gtan rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni tshad myed 16—482

si rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid ni stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshan ma myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni mtshan ma myed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /smon pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni smon pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid med pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mngon par shes pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /gzungs ①kyi sgo rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid 16—483

ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi 'byung bar ①'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi ②ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa skyed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad kyi ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi ②ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /myi 'jigs pa'i ngo bo nyid ni/16—484

myi 'jigs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa'i ngo bo nyid ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i ngo bo nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid skyed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar ①'dod pa de ni/ dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa skye bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ rang sangs rgyas skye bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' skye bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid skyed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dgra bcom pa'i ngo bo nyid ni/ dgra bcom pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro//16wa 485

byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ lan cig ①phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ dgra bcom pa nyid 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ rang byang chub 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ lam gyi rnam pa ⑤shes pa nyid 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ①'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /lan cig duphyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam 16—486

pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa med do/ /rang byang chub ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /lan cig ②phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid ni/ lan cig ③phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir rol/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid ni/dgra bcom pa nyid kyi dungo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rang byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid ni rang byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa ⑤shes pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi dungo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar ⑦'dod pa de ni/ mying 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ mtshan ma 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ brda 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 16—487

'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ tha snyad 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/gdags pa 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mying stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /mtshan ma stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /brda stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /tha snyad stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /gdags pa stong pa nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar mying stong pa nyid mying stong pa nyid kyi ①ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshan ma stong pa nyid mtshan ma stong pa nyid kyi ②ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /brda stong pa nyid brda stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /tha snyad stong pa nyid tha snyad stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /gdags pa stong pa nyid gdags pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir rol/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/skye ba myed pa 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ 'gag pa myed pa 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa ①de ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa 'byung bar 'dod du 16—488

zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ rnam par byang ba myed pa 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /rab 'byor gang mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams 'byung bar 'dod pa de ni/ mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa 'byung bar 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor skye ba myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /'gag pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa skyed do/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rnam par byang ba myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa'i ngo bo nyid ni khams gsum nas 'byung ba myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar skye ba myed pa ni/ skye ba skyed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'gag pa myed pa ni 'gag pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam par byang ba myed pa ni/ rnam par byang ba myed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa ni/ mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor de ①ltar rnam grangs 'dis na/ 'di ltar theg pa chen po ni khams gsum nas byung nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gnas par shes 16—489

par bya ste/ gnas ①de ni bskyod du myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang khyod kyis gang 'di skad du theg pa chen po de gang du gnas par 'gyur zhes smras pa de ni/ theg pa chen po de gang du yang gnas par 'gyur ba myed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni ②gnas myi dmyigs pa'i phyir myi gnas pa ste/ rab 'byor de ltar theg pa chen po de ni myi gnas pa'i tshul gyis gnas so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ chos kyi dbyings ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ de bzhin nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin/ myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/yang dag pa'i mtha' ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /yang dag pa'i mtha'i ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 16—490

'di ltar chos kyi dbyings chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin nyid de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' yang dag pa'i mtha'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nam mkha'i dbyings ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ 'dod chags zad pa'i dbyings ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ①ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ rab tu byang ba'i dbyings ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/dper na/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dbyings ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/dper na/ 'gog pa'i dbyings ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /'dod chags zad pa'i dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid la ni/ gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /rab tu 16—491

byang ba'i dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do//'gog pa'i dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar nam mkha'i dbyings nam mkha'i dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod chags zad pa'i dbyings 'dod chags zad pa'i dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab tu byang ba'i dbyings rab tu byang ba'i ①dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir ro//'dod chags dang bral ba'i dbyings 'dod chags dang ⑤bral ba'i dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'gog pa'i dbyings 'gog pa'i dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir ro// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu drug ①pa/rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ gzugs stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/dper na/ tshor ba stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ 'du shes stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ 'du byed stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa 16—492

chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ rnam par shes pa stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ①ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /'du shes kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /'du byed kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar gzugs gzugs kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /tshor ba tshor bas stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'du shes 'du shes kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'du byed 'du byed kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam par shes pa rnam par shes pas stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ myig stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/dper na/ rna ba stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ sna stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no//rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ lce stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin 16—493

myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/dper na/ lus stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no//rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na yid stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor lamyig gi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /rna ba'i ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /sna'i ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /lce'i ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /lus kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa myed do/ /yid kyi ngo bo nyid la ni gnas pa'am myi gnas pa skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar myig myig gis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rna ba rna bas stong pa'i phyir ro/ /sna snas stong pa'i phyir ro/ /lce lces stong pa'i phyir ro/ /lus lus kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /yid yid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na gzugs stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgra stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du theg pa chen po de yang gnas pa yang ma yin myi gnas pa yang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ dri stong pa nyid ni gnas pa yang ma 16—494
