smon pa myed pa ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la ma 'ongs pa'i dus myi dmyigs/mnyam pa nyid la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyang myi dmyigs te/ mnyam pa nyid kyang mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs na/ mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ da ltar byung ba'i dus dmyigs pa lta yang ci zhig smos/ rab 'byor mngon par shes pa rnams ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs/ mngon par shes pa rnams ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/ mngon par shes pa rnams ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/mngon par shes pa rnams ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus myi dmyigs/mnyam pa nyid la ma 'ongs pa'i dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyang myi dmyigs te/ mnyam pa nyid kyang mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs na / mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus ①dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ da ltar byung ba'i dus dmyigs pa lta yang ci zhig smos/ rab 'byor ting nge 'dzin rnams ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs / ting nge 'dzin rnams ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/ ting nge 'dzin rnams ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la ma 'ongs pa'i 16—712

dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyang myi dmyigs te/mnyam pa nyid kyang mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs na/ mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smosal/ da ltar byung ba'i dus dmyigs pa lta yang ci zhig smos/ rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus myi dmyigs/mnyam pa nyid la ma 'ongs pa'i dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyang myi dmyigs te/ mnyam pa nyid kyang mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs na / mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ da ltar byung ba'i dus dmyigs pa lta yang ci zhig smos/ rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus myi dmyigs/mnyam pa nyid la ma 'ongs pa'i dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyang mi dmyigs te/ mnyam pa nyid kyang mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs na / mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ da ltar byung ba'i dus dmyigs pa 16—713

lta yang ci zhig smos/ rab 'byor myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs / myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mnyam pa ①la 'das pa'i dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la ma 'ongs pa'i dus myi dmyigs/mnyam pa nyid la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyang myi dmyigs te/ mnyam pa nyid kyang mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs na/ mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ da ltar byung ba'i dus dmigs pa lta yang ci zhig smos/ rab 'byor so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni sngon gyi ②mthar myi dmyigs / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni dus gsum mnyam 0pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la ma 'ongs pa'i dus myi dmyigs/ mnyam pa nyid la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyang myi dmyigs te/ mnyam pa nyid kyang mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs na/ mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ da ltar byung ba'i dus dmyigs pa lta yang ci zhig smos/ ⑤rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 16—714

'dres pa brtswa brgyad ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la mi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus mi dmyigs/mnyam pa nyid la ma 'ongs pa'i dus myi dmigs/ mnyam pa nyid la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyang mi dmyigs te/ mnyam pa nyid kyang mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs na / mnyam pa nyid la 'das pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dmyigs pa lta ci zhig smos/ da ltar byung ba'i dus dmyigs pa lta yang ci zhig smos/ rab 'byor gzhan yang so so'i skye bo ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs / so so'i skye bo ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/ so so'i skye bo ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/ so so'i skye bo ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la mi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nyan thos ni sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs/ nyan thos ni phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs/ nyan thos ni da ltar byung bar mi dmyigs/ nyan thos ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la mi dmigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can dmigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang rang sangs rgyas ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs rang sangs rgyas ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs rang sangs rgyas ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/ rang sangs rgyas ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs/byang chub sems dpa' ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/ byang chub sems dpa' ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te①/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems 16—715

can dmyigs su myed pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa ni sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs / de bzhin gshegs pa ni da ltar byung bar myi dmyigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la myi dmyigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/sems can dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid ①la bslabs ②shing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par bya ste/ rab 'byor 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po dus gsum mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba ste/ de la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lha dang / myi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'byung ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyis de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi theg pa chen po dus gsum mnyam pa nyid ces bgyi ba 'di/ legs par gsungs pa ni legs shing dge ste/ bcom ldan 'das theg pa chen po 'di la bslabs shing 'das ②pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob po/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten tshad dang grangs ma mchis pa dag na/16—716

dpag tu ma mchis pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mchis pa ①rnams ②spyang theg pa chen po 'di nyid la bslabs shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du dus gsum mnyam pa nyid ces bgyi ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi theg pa chen po'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ theg pa chen po 'di la bslabs shing 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid brnyes par gyur to/ /brnyes so brnyes par 'gyur ro/ / shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bcu gcig go// //⑧shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gsum dupa/ de nas byams gang gi bus/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das gnas brtan rab 'byor 'di ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i slad du/ bsko ⑤ba mdzad pas/ 'di ni theg pa chen po bstan pa tsam du sems so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gam/gcig gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / 'gal bar theg pa chen po 16—717

bstan par ma gyur lags grang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de ltar gyur pa yang myed de/ rab 'byor khyod ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang rjes su mthun par theg pa chen po ston to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar dge ba'i chos gang yang rung ste/ nyan thos kyi chos sam / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos sam/sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag thams cad kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang du 'dus shing khongs su chud do/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang du 'dus shing khongs su chud pa/ de lta bu'i nyan thos kyi chos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag gang lags bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ①'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs ②lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ②rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang /tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang /④mngon par shes pa drug dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi 16—718

stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / ⑨ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad dang / myi nyam ②pa'i chos nyid dang / rtag tu btang snyoms kyi rnam par spyod pa ste/rab 'byor de dag ni dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs gang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang du 'dus shing ②khongs su chud par 'dod pa duste/ nyan thos kyi chos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos so/ /rab 'byor de la theg pa chen po gang yin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gange yin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang 16—719

yin pa dang / gzugs gang yin pa dang / tshor ba gang yin pa dang /'du shes gang yin pa dang / 'du byed gang yin pa dang / rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / myig gang yin pa dang / gzugs gang yin pa dang /myig gi rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / rna ba gang yin pa dang / sgra gang yin pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / sna gang yin pa dang / dri gang yin pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / lce gang yin pa dang / ro gang yin pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / lus gang yin pa dang / reg gang yin pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / yid gang yin pa dang / chos gang yin pa dang /yid kyi rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gang yin pa dang / yid kyi ①'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gang yin pa dang / sa'i khams gang yin pa dang / chu'i khams gang yin pa dang / mye'i khams gang yin pa dang / rlung gi khams gang yin pa dang / nam mkha'i khams gang yin pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams gang yin pa dang /② ma rig pa gang 16—720

yin pa dang / 'du byed gang yin pa dang / rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / mying dang gzugs gang yin pa dang / skye mched drug gang yin pa dang /reg pa gang yin pa dang / tshor ba gang yin pa dang / sred pa gang yin pa dang / len pa gang yin pa dang / srid pa gang yin pa dang / skye ba gang yin pa dang / rga shi gang yin pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / stong pa ①nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gang yin pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams gang yin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams gang yin 16—721

pa dang / dbang po rnams gang yin pa dang / stobs rnams gang yin pa dang /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams gang yin pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gang yin pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gang yin pa dang /bsam gtan rnams/ gang yin pa dang / tshad skyed pa rnams/ gang yin pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams/ gang yin pa dang /mngon par shes pa drug gang yin pa dang / zil kyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad gang yin pa dang / rgyas pa'i skye mched bcu gang yin pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad gang yin pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gang yin pa dang / sdug bsngal gang yin pa dang / kun 'byung ba gang yin pa dang / 'gog pa gang yin pa dang / lam gang yin pa dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gang yin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gang yin pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo gang yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gang yin pa dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi gang yin pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gang yin pa dang / ①snying rje chen po gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad gang yin pa dang / 'dod pa'i khams gang yin pa dang /gzugs kyi khams gang yin pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i khams gang yin pa dang / dge ba'i chos gang yin pa dang / myi dge ba'i chos gang yin pa dang /zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos gang yin pa dang / zag pa myed pa'i chos gang yin pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i chos gang yin pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos gang yin pa dang / 'dus byas kyi chos gang yin pa dang / 'dus 16—722

ma byas kyi chos gang yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gang yin pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa'i chos gang yin pa dang / 'dul ba gang yin pa dang / chos kyi dbyings gang yin pa dang / de bzhin nyid gang yin pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings gang yin pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad ni bden ①pa yang ma yin/ myi bden ②pa yang ma yin te③/ gzugs myed pa bstan du myed pa/ thogs pa myed pa/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid myed par mtshan dunyid gcig pa sha stag ste/ rab 'byor rnam grangs 'dis na/ khyod shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / mthun par theg pa chen po ston to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gnyis su myed de/ gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu 16—723

phyin pa yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /①theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /②theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang /nang stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la / phyi stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de①/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / phyi stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do / /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su phyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de'u/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / chen po stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de 16—724

gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de①/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa ②nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar 16—725

myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /②theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de②/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de②/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang gzhan ④zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ dbang po rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / dbang po rnams kyang gnyis su myed de/ gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ stobs rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang /stobs rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang 16—726

gzhan la/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba skyed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ bsam gtan rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / bsam gtan rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ tshad myed pa rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / tshad med pa rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de①/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang gnyis su myed de/gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms ②par 'jug pa dgu yang gnyis 16—727

su ②skyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams kyang gnyis su myed de/ gnyis su byar med do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang gnyis su myed de ②gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang chaganyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang ④gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ snying rje chen po yang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de 16—728

ltar na theg pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po yang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /theg pa chen po yang gzhan la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de/ de ltar na theg pa chen po dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa yang ①gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na ②theg pa chen po bstan pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pas theg pa chen po bstan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' ni sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni dbus su myi dmyigs te/ gzugs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bgyi'o/ /tshor ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bgyi'o/ /'du shes kun tu mtha' yas pa'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bgyi'o/ /'du byed kun tu mtha' yas pa'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' ①kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bgyi'o//rnam par shes pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bgyi ste/ gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de lta bu yang ma mchis myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de lta bu yang ma mchis myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de lta bu yang ma mchis myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed byang chub sems 16—729

dpa' zhes bgyi ba de lta bu yang ma mchis myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de lta bu yang ma mchis myi dmyigs te/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' thams cad du thams cadarka/ rnam pa thams cad du thams cad yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ste/ma dmyigs na/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyang ril gyis yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ma ①dmyigs na/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams shing ②bstan par bgyi/bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba 'di ni mying tsam du bas te/bcom ldan 'das ji ltar bdag bdag ces bgyi ba yang/ bdag la mngon par grub pa ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba yang / byang chub sems dpa' ②mngon par grub pa ma mchis so/ /de ltar rang bzhin ma mchis pa'i chos rnams la / gang mngon par grub pa'i gzugs lta yang gang zhig mchis/ gang mngon par grub pa'i tshor ba lta yang gang zhig mchis/ gang mngon par grub pa'i 'du shes lta yang gang zhig mchis/ gang mngon par grub pa'i 'du byed lta yang gang zhig mchis/ gang mngon par grub pa'i rnam par shes pa 0lta yang gang zhig mchis/ bcom ldan 'das gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni/gzugs ma lags/ gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni tshor ba ma lags / gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni 'du shes ma lags/ gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni 'du byed ma lags/ gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni/ rnam par shes pa 16—730

ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de lta lags la mngon par ma grub pa las gud na yang / gang byang chub tu spyod par 'gyur ba'i/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dmyigs su ma mchis na/ mngon par ma grub pa mngon par ma grub pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams su mchis sam/ gal te de ltar bstan pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems myi 'jum yongs ①su myi 'jum/ 'gyod par myi 'gyur zhing yid myi 'jigs myi sngang ②/ skrag par myi 'gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra ①dwa ti'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sngon gyi mthar dmyigs su myed pa yin/ phyi ma'i mthar dmyigs su myed pa yin/dbus su dmyigs su myed pa yin/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/gzugs kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya ba yin/ tshor ba kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya ba yin/ 'du shes kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya ba yin/ 'du byed kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya ba yin/ rnam par shes pa kun tu mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' kun tu mtha' yas par rig par bya ba yin/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs pa yin/ tshor ba byang chub 16—731

sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs pa yin/ 'du shes byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs pa yin/'du byed byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs pa yin / rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang myed cing myi dmyigs pa yin/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad du thams cad rnam pa thams cad du thams cad yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ma dmyigs na/byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ①la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi ②zhes smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/de skad du byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyang ril kyis yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ma dmyigs na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi zhes smra/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba 'di ni mying tsam du bas so zhes smra/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du ji ltar bdag bdag ces bgyi yang / bdag ni mngon par grub pa ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi yang byang chub sems dpa' ni mngon par grub ③pa ma mchis so/ /de ltar chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin la/ gzugs mngon par grub pa lta yang gang zhig mchis/ tshor ba mngon par grub pa lta yang gang zhig mchis/ 'du shes mngon par grub pa lta yang gang zhig mchis/ 'du byed mngon par grub pa 16—732

lta yang gang zhig mchis/ rnam par shes pa mngon par grub pa lta yang gang zhig mchis te/ gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni gzugs ma lags so/ /gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni tshor ba ma lags so/ /gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni 'du shes ma lags so/ /gang mngon par ma grub pa de ①ni 'du byed ma lags so/ /gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma lags so/ /zhes smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du mngon par ma grub pa zhig /mngon par ma grub pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ②pa la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi'am zhes smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na/ de skad du mngon par ma grub pa las gud na yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bgyi ba dmyigs su ma mchis so zhes smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir na de skad du gal te de ltar bstan pa'i tshe/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems myi 'jum yongs su myi 'jum 'gyod par myi 'gyur zhing / yid myi 'jigs myi sngang nispag par myi 'gyur na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do zhes smra/ de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu sems can med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sems can stong pa dang / sems can dben pa dang /sems can rang bzhin myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra du duti'i bu sems can myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sems can stong pa dang /16—733

sems can dben pa dang / sems can rang bzhin myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/sems can myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /sems can stong pa dang / sems can dben pa dang / sems can rang bzhin myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can myed pa dang /sems can stong pa dang / sems can dben pa dang / sems can rang bzhin myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' ①gi dmyigs so/ /phyi ma'i mtha' ②phyi dmyigs so//dbus nimyi dmyigs so/ /sems can myed pa yang gzhan/ sems can stong pa yang gzhan/ sems can dben pa yang gzhan/ sems can rang bzhin skyed pa yang gzhan zhig la byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan zhig ste0/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan/ dbus kyang gzhan zhes bya ba myed de.e/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na sems can skyed pa gang yin pa dang / sems can stong pa gang yin pa dang / sems can dben pa gang yin pa dang / sems can rang bzhin myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/gzugs myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so//gzugs dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /16—734

gzugs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs stong pa nyid kyi phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ gzugs myed pa dang / gzugs stong pa nyid dang / gzugs dben pa dang / gzugs ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs①/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ gzugs myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ gzugs stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/gzugs dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ gzugs ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na/ gzugs myed pa gang yin pa dang / gzugs stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gzugs dben pa gang yin pa dang / gzugs ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i 16—735

mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa dang ①sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshor ba myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' zhuphyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' ②dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu tshor ba myed pa dang / tshor ba stong pa nyid dang /tshor ba dben pa dang / tshor ba ngo bo nyid myed pa la/ sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ tshor ba myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ tshor ba stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ tshor ba dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ tshor ba ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/16—736

phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na tshor ba myed pa gang yin pa dang / tshor ba stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / tshor ba dben pa gang yin pa dang / tshor ba ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa/ de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de ①gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'du shes myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar mi dmyigs so/ /'du shes dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar ②kyi dmyigs so/ /'du shes myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//'du shes dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so//'du shes ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'du shes myed pa dang / 'du shes stong pa nyid dang / 'du shes 16—737

dben pa dang / 'du shes ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ 'du shes myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ 'du shes stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ 'du shes dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ 'du shes ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na 'du shes myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'du shes stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / 'du shes dben pa gang yin pa dang / 'du shes ngo bo nyid myed pa ①gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi ②mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang /dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar ②skyed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'du byed myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed stong pa nyid kyi phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi 16—738

dmyigs so/ /'du byed stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'du byed myed pa dang / 'du byed stong pa nyid dang / 'du byed dben pa dang /'du byed ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ 'du byed myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/'du byed stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ 'du byed dben pa yang gzhan ma yin 'du byed ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ltar na 'du byed myed pa gang yin pa dang / 'du byed stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / 'du byed dben pa gang yin pa dang / 'du byed ngo bo nyid myed pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu rnam par shes pa myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa dben pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam 16—739

gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myig stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myig dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myig ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myig myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myig stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myig dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myig ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /myig myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /myig stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /myig dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /myig ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ myig myed pa dang / myig stong pa nyid dang / myig dben pa dang / myig ngo bo nyid myed pa la sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs te/ myig myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ myig stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ myig dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ myig ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang 16—741

dmyigs te/ rna ba myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ rna ①ba stong pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ rna ba dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ rna ba ngo bo nyid myed pa yang gzhan ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin/ sngon gyi mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin/ dbus kyang gzhan ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ de ltar na rna ba myed pa gang yin pa dang / rna ba stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / rna ba dben pa gang yin pa dang / rna ba ngo bo nyid myed pa ②gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' gang yin pa dang / phyi ma'i mtha' gang yin pa dang / dbus gang yin pa de thams cad kyang gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ sna med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sna stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sna dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sna ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi dumathar myi dmyigs so/ /sna myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sna stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar mi dmyigs so/ /sna dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sna ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar myi dmyigs so/ /sna myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /sna stong pa nyid kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' rjodabus su myi dmyigs so/ /sna dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dbus su myi dmyigs so/ /sna ngo bo nyid myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' 16—743
